title.zh: 卷314 列傳一百一 策楞 玉保 达尔党阿 哈达哈 永常 觉罗雅尔哈善 富德 萨赖尔
title.en: Volume 314 Biographies 101: Ce Leng, Yu Bao, Da Er Dang A, Ha Da Ha, Yong Chang, Jue Luo Ya Er Ha Shan, Fu De, Sa Lai Er
title.raw: 卷314 列傳一百一 策楞 玉保 达尔党阿 哈达哈 永常 觉罗雅尔哈善 富德 萨赖尔

sentences.zh: 列傳一百一

translations.literal: Biographies 101
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 101

sentences.zh: 策楞子特通額特清額特成額玉保達爾黨阿哈達哈子哈寧阿

translations.literal: Ce Leng; [his sons] Tetong'e, Teqing'e, and Techeng'e; Yu Bao; Da Erdang'a; Ha Daha; Zi Haning'a
translations.idiomatic: Ce Leng; Tetong'e, Teqing'e, and Techeng'e; Yu Bao; Da Erdang'a; Ha Daha; and Zi Haning'a

sentences.zh: 永常覺羅雅爾哈善富德薩賴爾

translations.literal: Yong Chang; Aisin Gioro Ya Erhashan; Fu De; Salai'er
translations.idiomatic: Yong Chang; Aisin Gioro Ya Erhashan; Fu De; and Salai'er

sentences.zh: 策楞，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，尹德長子。

translations.literal: Ce Leng, of the Niohuru clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and the eldest son of Yinde.
translations.idiomatic: Ce Leng belonged to the Niohuru clan, came from the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, and was Yinde's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，為御前侍衛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign, he served as an imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign he served as an imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 二年秋，永定河決，上出帑命策楞如盧溝橋賑災民。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year, the Yongding River burst its banks; the emperor disbursed treasury funds and ordered Ce Leng to go to Lugou Bridge to relieve the disaster victims.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn in the second year the Yongding River broke its banks; the emperor released treasury funds and sent Ce Leng to Lugou Bridge to aid the flood victims.

sentences.zh: 累遷為廣州將軍，授兩廣總督。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to General of Guangzhou and appointed Governor-General of the Two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to General of Guangzhou and was appointed governor-general of the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 廣東巡撫託庸劾布政使唐綏祖贓私，下策楞勘讞。

translations.literal: The Guangdong provincial governor Tuoyong impeached the provincial administration commissioner Tang Suizu for corruption; the case was referred to Ce Leng for investigation and judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong governor Tuoyong impeached provincial administration commissioner Tang Suizu for graft, and the case was sent to Ce Leng for investigation and adjudication.

sentences.zh: 策楞雪綏祖枉，上嘉其秉公。

translations.literal: Ce Leng cleared Suizu of the false charge; the emperor praised his impartiality.
translations.idiomatic: Ce Leng cleared Suizu of wrongful accusation, and the emperor commended his fairness.

sentences.zh: 尋加太子少傅，移兩江總督。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was made Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and transferred to be Governor-General of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was made Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and transferred to governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 其弟訥親承父爵進為一等公，以徵金川失律坐譴。

translations.literal: His younger brother Neqin inherited their father's title and was advanced to a first-rank duke, but was punished for military misconduct in the campaign against Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Neqin had inherited their father's title and been raised to a first-rank duke, but was censured for misconduct during the Jinchuan campaign.

sentences.zh: 十三年十月，命策楞襲爵，仍為二等公，复移川陝總督。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the thirteenth year, Ce Leng was ordered to inherit the title, retaining the rank of second-rank duke, and was again transferred to be Governor-General of Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the thirteenth year Ce Leng was ordered to inherit the title as a second-rank duke and was again made governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 旋以川、陝轄地廣，析置二督，策楞專領四川。

translations.literal: Soon, because the jurisdictions of Sichuan and Shaanxi were vast, two governorships were created; Ce Leng was placed solely in charge of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Because the combined Sichuan-Shaanxi jurisdiction was too large, the post was soon split in two, and Ce Leng was left in charge of Sichuan alone.

sentences.zh: 時大學士傅恆代訥親為經略，命策楞參贊軍務。

translations.literal: At that time Grand Secretary Fu Heng replaced Neqin as campaign commander; Ce Leng was ordered to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Fu Heng had replaced Neqin as campaign commander, and Ce Leng was ordered to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 傅恆受金川降，班師行賞，策楞加太子太保。

translations.literal: Fu Heng accepted the surrender of Jinchuan; when the army withdrew and rewards were distributed, Ce Leng was made Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: After Fu Heng accepted Jinchuan's surrender and the army withdrew to distribute rewards, Ce Leng was made Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 西藏郡王珠爾默特那木札勒狡暴，謀為亂，上命策楞戒備。

translations.literal: The Tibetan princely lord Dondrub Namgyal was cunning and violent and plotted rebellion; the emperor ordered Ce Leng to take precautions.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan prince Dondrub Namgyal was treacherous and violent and plotted rebellion, and the emperor ordered Ce Leng to stand ready.

sentences.zh: 十五年冬，駐藏大臣傅清、拉布敦誅珠爾默特那木札勒，為其黨所戕，西藏亂，上命策楞及提督岳鍾琪督師戡難。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifteenth year, the resident ministers in Tibet Fu Qing and Labdon executed Dondrub Namgyal but were themselves killed by his faction; Tibet fell into disorder, and the emperor ordered Ce Leng and provincial military commander Yue Zhongqi to lead troops to suppress the crisis.
translations.idiomatic: That winter in the fifteenth year the Tibetan resident ministers Fu Qing and Labdon killed Dondrub Namgyal but were slain by his followers; with Tibet in turmoil, the emperor ordered Ce Leng and provincial commander Yue Zhongqi to lead troops and restore order.

sentences.zh: 時西藏公班第達獲逆渠卓呢、羅卜藏扎布，戢兵待命。

translations.literal: At that time the Tibetan official Bandi had captured the rebel leaders Zhuoni and Luobuzangzhabu; the troops had been restrained and were awaiting orders.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Tibetan official Bandi had captured the rebel leaders Zhuoni and Luobuzangzhabu, and the forces had stood down awaiting further orders.

sentences.zh: 策楞以聞，請率八百人以往，留軍駐打箭爐待徵發。

translations.literal: Ce Leng reported this and requested to lead eight hundred men forward, leaving troops stationed at Dartsedo to await mobilization.
translations.idiomatic: Ce Leng reported the situation and asked to lead eight hundred men ahead while leaving troops at Dartsedo to await full mobilization.

sentences.zh: 策楞至西藏，與鍾琪及侍郎兆惠，駐藏大臣納穆札爾、班第等審定規制，為西藏善後章程，語詳西藏傳。

translations.literal: When Ce Leng reached Tibet, he joined with Zhongqi, Vice Minister Zhao Hui, and the resident ministers Namuzha'er, Bandi, and others to review regulations and draw up the post-crisis charter for Tibet; the details are given in the Tibet biography.
translations.idiomatic: After Ce Leng reached Tibet, he worked with Zhongqi, Vice Minister Zhao Hui, and resident ministers Namuzha'er, Bandi, and others to settle regulations and draft Tibet's post-crisis charter; the full account appears in the Tibet biography.

sentences.zh: 雜穀土司蒼旺侵梭磨、卓克基二土司為亂，策楞與鍾琪發兵討之。

translations.literal: The Zagu tusi Cangwang invaded the two tusi domains of Suomo and Zhuokeji and raised a rebellion; Ce Leng and Zhongqi dispatched troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: The Zagu chieftain Cangwang invaded the Suomo and Zhuokeji domains and rebelled, and Ce Leng and Zhongqi sent troops against him.

sentences.zh: 上以川兵弱，當瞻對、金川用兵後，元氣未復，誡慎重。

translations.literal: The emperor considered Sichuan troops weak and, after the campaigns in Zhandui and Jinchuan, their strength not yet restored, and admonished them to act with caution.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor judged Sichuan's forces still weakened after the Zhandui and Jinchuan wars and warned them to proceed carefully.

sentences.zh: 師戰勝，獲蒼旺，收其地內屬。

translations.literal: The army was victorious, Cangwang was captured, and his territory was brought under direct administration.
translations.idiomatic: The army won, Cangwang was taken, and his lands were annexed to direct rule.

sentences.zh: 策楞丁母憂，解官還京師。

translations.literal: Ce Leng entered mourning for his mother, resigned his office, and returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Ce Leng's mother died he left office and returned to the capital in mourning.

sentences.zh: 江南淮、揚水災，命偕尚書劉統勳往勘。

translations.literal: Floods struck the Huai and Yang regions of Jiangnan; he was ordered to go with Minister Liu Tongxun to inspect the damage.
translations.idiomatic: When floods hit the Huai and Yang regions in Jiangnan, he was sent with Minister Liu Tongxun to survey the disaster.

sentences.zh: 因疏河工積習，總督高斌以下皆坐黜，即令策楞署南河總督。

translations.literal: Because he exposed long-standing abuses in river works, Governor-General Gao Bin and others below him were all dismissed; Ce Leng was immediately ordered to act as Governor-General of the Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: His memorial exposing entrenched abuses in river works led to the dismissal of Governor-General Gao Bin and others, and Ce Leng was at once ordered to serve as acting governor-general of the Southern Rivers.

sentences.zh: 河決銅山張家馬路，上以河工非所習，改授兩廣總督。

translations.literal: The river broke through at Zhangjia Malu in Tongshan; because river works were not his specialty, the emperor transferred him to be Governor-General of the Two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: When the river burst at Zhangjia Malu in Tongshan, the emperor decided river works were outside his expertise and reassigned him as governor-general of the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 時準噶爾酋達瓦齊庸懦，所部內訌。

translations.literal: At that time the Dzungar chief Dawachi was weak and cowardly, and his followers were torn by internal strife.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Dzungar leader Dawachi was weak and indecisive, and his people were riven by internal conflict.

sentences.zh: 上銳意用兵，十九年二月，召策楞，命出視師，授定邊左副將軍。

translations.literal: The emperor was determined to use force; in the second month of the nineteenth year he summoned Ce Leng, ordered him to take command in the field, and appointed him Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Intent on war, in the second month of the nineteenth year the emperor summoned Ce Leng, sent him to take the field, and appointed him Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納之降也，尚書舒赫德在軍察其狙詐，慮且復叛，策楞與共議，以所攜部族置戈壁南，而留阿睦爾撒納及諸頭人丁壯勝兵者從軍。

translations.literal: When Amursana surrendered, Minister Shuhede with the army perceived his cunning and feared he would rebel again; Ce Leng discussed the matter with him and proposed placing the tribes Amursana had brought south of the Gobi, while keeping Amursana and the tribal leaders together with their able-bodied elite troops with the army.
translations.idiomatic: When Amursana surrendered, Minister Shuhede in camp saw his treachery and feared another revolt; Ce Leng agreed with him to settle Amursana's tribes south of the Gobi while keeping Amursana, the headmen, and their best fighting men with the army.

sentences.zh: 上聞阿睦爾撒納降，將倚以取達瓦齊，得策楞等疏，怒甚，命削職，以閒散在參贊上效力贖罪，發諸子各行省駐防披甲。

translations.literal: The emperor, hearing of Amursana's surrender and intending to rely on him to take Dawachi, received the memorial from Ce Leng and others and was greatly angered; he ordered Ce Leng stripped of rank, to serve as a supernumerary above the rank of military assistant to atone for his offense, and sent his sons to garrison duty in the provinces in common soldier status.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had hoped to use the newly surrendered Amursana against Dawachi; when he read Ce Leng's memorial he was furious, stripped Ce Leng of rank, reduced him to supernumerary service above military assistant to redeem himself, and sent his sons to provincial garrisons as common soldiers.

sentences.zh: 上遂用阿睦爾撒納為定邊左副將軍，導我師討達瓦齊。

translations.literal: The emperor then employed Amursana as Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier to guide our army in attacking Dawachi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then made Amursana Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier and had him guide the army against Dawachi.

sentences.zh: 二十年五月，師定伊犁，上降詔猶責策楞、舒赫德恇怯乖張，幾僨事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twentieth year the army secured Yili; the emperor issued an edict still blaming Ce Leng and Shuhede for cowardice and perversity, saying they had nearly ruined the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twentieth year the army took Yili, yet the emperor's edict still rebuked Ce Leng and Shuhede for timidity and obstinacy, saying they had nearly wrecked the campaign.

sentences.zh: 旋以師有功，予策楞副都統銜，令率偏師戍巴里坤。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, because the army had merit, Ce Leng was given the rank of vice commander-in-chief and ordered to lead a detached force to garrison Barkol.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, for the army's merit, Ce Leng was given vice commander-in-chief rank and ordered to lead a detached column to garrison Barkol.

sentences.zh: 九月，阿睦爾撒納叛去，上以永常為定西將軍，命策楞參贊大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Amursana rebelled and fled; the emperor appointed Yongchang as General for the Pacification of the West and ordered Ce Leng to serve as a senior military assistant.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Amursana rebelled and fled; the emperor made Yongchang General for the Pacification of the West and ordered Ce Leng to serve as senior military assistant.

sentences.zh: 既，聞當阿陸爾撒納叛時，永常引師自穆壘左次巴里坤，罷永常將軍，以命策楞。

translations.literal: Later, hearing that when Amursana rebelled Yongchang had led the army from Mulei and halted at Barkol, the emperor dismissed Yongchang as general and gave the command to Ce Leng.
translations.idiomatic: Learning later that when Amursana rebelled Yongchang had withdrawn from Mulei and camped at Barkol, the emperor removed Yongchang and gave the command to Ce Leng.

sentences.zh: 旋詔逮永常，授扎拉豐阿為將軍。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered Yongchang arrested and Zhalafeng'a appointed general.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict ordered Yongchang arrested and appointed Zhalafeng'a general in his place.

sentences.zh: 策楞疏言待軍士器械，隨將軍進兵。

translations.literal: Ce Leng memorialized that he was waiting for the troops' weapons and equipment and would advance with the general.
translations.idiomatic: Ce Leng reported that he was waiting on arms and equipment for the troops and would advance with the general.

sentences.zh: 詔並逮策楞，謂懲其懦也。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered Ce Leng arrested, saying this was to punish his cowardice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered Ce Leng arrested as punishment for cowardice.

sentences.zh: 尋以罪在永常，貸策楞，令屬扎拉豐阿督餉。

translations.literal: Soon, because the fault lay with Yongchang, Ce Leng was pardoned and ordered to serve under Zhalafeng'a supervising supplies.
translations.idiomatic: When blame was laid on Yongchang, Ce Leng was pardoned and ordered to serve under Zhalafeng'a overseeing supplies.

sentences.zh: 會準噶爾宰桑克什木等陷伊犁，定北將軍班第等死事。

translations.literal: At the same time the Dzungar zaisang Keshimu and others seized Yili; General for the Pacification of the North Bandi and others died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Dzungar zaisang Keshimu and others overran Yili, and General for the Pacification of the North Bandi and others were killed in action.

sentences.zh: 策楞馳疏聞，請合兵進討。

translations.literal: Ce Leng sent an urgent memorial reporting this and requested that the armies unite to advance and attack.
translations.idiomatic: Ce Leng sent an urgent report and asked that the armies combine for a joint advance.

sentences.zh: 上复授策楞副都統銜參贊大臣，扎拉豐阿未至，攝將軍。

translations.literal: The emperor again gave Ce Leng the rank of vice commander-in-chief and the post of military assistant; before Zhalafeng'a arrived, Ce Leng acted as general.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again gave Ce Leng vice commander-in-chief rank as military assistant, and with Zhalafeng'a not yet arrived Ce Leng acted as general.

sentences.zh: 策楞與喀爾喀諸部貝勒合兵擊敗準噶爾部落，授內大臣，真除定西將軍。

translations.literal: Ce Leng joined with the Khalkha princes in a combined force and defeated the Dzungar tribes; he was made a grand minister and formally appointed General for the Pacification of the West.
translations.idiomatic: Ce Leng joined Khalkha princes in a combined attack that defeated the Dzungar tribes; he was made grand minister and confirmed as General for the Pacification of the West.

sentences.zh: 上督諸將逐捕阿睦爾撒納甚急。

translations.literal: The emperor urgently pressed the generals to pursue and capture Amursana.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pressed the generals urgently to hunt down Amursana.

sentences.zh: 二十一年二月，策楞聞台吉諾爾布等已得阿睦爾撒納，騰章奏捷，上告於陵廟。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-first year Ce Leng heard that the taiji Nuo'erbu and others had captured Amursana; he submitted a rapid memorial announcing victory, and the emperor reported it at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-first year Ce Leng heard that taiji Nuo'erbu and others had taken Amursana; he sent a victory dispatch, and the emperor reported the news at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 進策楞一等公，賜雙眼孔雀翎、寶石帽頂、四團龍補服。

translations.literal: Ce Leng was advanced to a first-rank duke and granted double-eyed peacock feathers, a jeweled hat knob, and a four-dragon roundel surcoat.
translations.idiomatic: Ce Leng was raised to first-rank duke and given double-eyed peacock feathers, a jeweled hat finial, and a four-dragon surcoat.

sentences.zh: 三月，策楞复疏言前奏非實，上命停封賞，嚴促進兵逐捕。

translations.literal: In the third month Ce Leng again memorialized that his earlier report was untrue; the emperor ordered the rewards halted and sternly urged an advance to pursue and capture Amursana.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Ce Leng admitted his earlier report was false; the emperor halted the rewards and sharply ordered the army forward to capture Amursana.

sentences.zh: 是月，复克伊犁，阿睦爾撒納走哈薩克。

translations.literal: That month Yili was recovered again; Amursana fled to the Kazakhs.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yili was retaken and Amursana fled into Kazakh territory.

sentences.zh: 四月，命大學士傅恆視師，逮策楞及參贊大臣玉保。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Grand Secretary Fu Heng was ordered to inspect the army; Ce Leng and military assistant Yu Bao were arrested.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Grand Secretary Fu Heng was sent to inspect the army, and Ce Leng and military assistant Yu Bao were arrested.

sentences.zh: 旋得策楞奏，方督兵壓哈薩克境，令擒阿睦爾撒納以獻。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Ce Leng's memorial arrived, saying he was directing troops to press the Kazakh border and ordering Amursana seized and presented.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ce Leng reported that he was pressing the Kazakh frontier and had ordered Amursana seized and sent in.

sentences.zh: 上乃令傅恆還京師。

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered Fu Heng to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered Fu Heng back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 時達爾黨阿出西路，哈達哈出北路，與策楞合軍以進，師久次，不得阿睦爾撒納踪跡。

translations.literal: At that time Da Erdang'a advanced by the western route and Ha Daha by the northern route; they joined Ce Leng and advanced together, but the army camped for a long time without finding any trace of Amursana.
translations.idiomatic: Da Erdang'a marched by the western route and Ha Daha by the northern, joining Ce Leng in a combined advance, but the army lingered for months without finding Amursana.

sentences.zh: 九月，達爾黨阿、哈達哈引兵還屯哈薩拉克。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Da Erdang'a and Ha Daha withdrew their troops and encamped at Hasalak.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Da Erdang'a and Ha Daha pulled back and encamped at Hasalak.

sentences.zh: 十一月，復命逮策楞、玉保檻送京師，途遇準噶爾兵，為所戕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month orders again went out to arrest Ce Leng and Yu Bao and send them to the capital in the cangue; on the way they met Dzungar troops and were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Ce Leng and Yu Bao were again ordered arrested and sent to the capital in the cangue; en route they met Dzungar troops and were killed.

sentences.zh: 子特通額，初發黑龍江披甲。

translations.literal: His son Tetong'e was first dispatched from Heilongjiang as a common soldier.
translations.idiomatic: His son Tetong'e had first been sent from Heilongjiang as a common soldier.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，以侍衛從將軍兆惠討霍集占，戰黑水，與總兵高天喜等同戰死。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, as a bodyguard he followed General Zhao Hui against Khoja Jahan; at the Battle of the Black River he died in action together with Regional Commander Gao Tianxi and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he followed General Zhao Hui against Khoja Jahan as a bodyguard and was killed at the Black River fighting alongside Regional Commander Gao Tianxi and others.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列後五十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the later fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was hung in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the later fifty meritorious officials.

sentences.zh: 特清額，初發杭州披甲。

translations.literal: Teqing'e was first dispatched from Hangzhou as a common soldier.
translations.idiomatic: Teqing'e had first been sent from Hangzhou as a common soldier.

sentences.zh: 自上虞備用處拜唐阿，十一遷，至嘉慶間，授成都將軍。

translations.literal: From a clerk at the Shangyu reserve office he rose through eleven promotions and, by the Jiaqing reign, was appointed General of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a clerk in the Shangyu reserve office he rose through eleven promotions and by the Jiaqing reign was made General of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 嘗兩攝四川總督。

translations.literal: He twice served as acting Governor-General of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He twice acted as governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 會有為蜀都賦訐長吏者，給事中胡大成以聞。

translations.literal: It happened that someone composed a Fu on the Capital of Shu to denounce a senior official; Censor Hu Dacheng reported it.
translations.idiomatic: When someone wrote a Fu on the Capital of Shu to denounce a senior official, supervising secretary Hu Dacheng reported it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 仁宗命工部尚書託津、光祿寺少卿盧廕溥詣勘，特清額坐徇隱，降三級留任。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong ordered Minister of Works Tuojin and Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments Lu Yinpu to go and investigate; Teqing'e was punished for concealment, demoted three ranks, and retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong sent Minister of Works Tuojin and Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments Lu Yinpu to investigate; Teqing'e was found to have covered up wrongdoing, demoted three ranks, and kept in post.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 特成額，初發西安披甲。

translations.literal: Techeng'e was first dispatched from Xi'an as a common soldier.
translations.idiomatic: Techeng'e had first been sent from Xi'an as a common soldier.

sentences.zh: 自黏竿處拜唐阿，再遷三等侍衛。

translations.literal: From a clerk in the pole-handling office he was promoted twice to third-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: From a clerk in the pole-handling office he was twice promoted to third-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 師討大金川酋索諾木，高宗命特成額從征。

translations.literal: When the army campaigned against the Greater Jinchuan chief Suonuomu, Emperor Gaozong ordered Techeng'e to follow the expedition.
translations.idiomatic: When the army marched against Greater Jinchuan chief Suonuomu, Emperor Gaozong ordered Techeng'e to join the campaign.

sentences.zh: 轉戰兩年，自資理北山下克美美卡諸地；

translations.literal: After two years of campaigning, from north of Zili he captured Meimeika and other places;
translations.idiomatic: After two years of fighting he took Meimeika and other positions north of Zili;

sentences.zh: 攻榮噶爾博最高★，奪康薩爾山半石碉；

translations.literal: he attacked the highest fort at Ronggaerbo and seized the half-stone blockhouse on Kangsa'er Mountain;
translations.idiomatic: he stormed the highest fort at Ronggaerbo and seized the half-stone blockhouse on Kangsa'er Mountain;

sentences.zh: 破密拉噶拉木山樑木城：特成額皆有功，授貴州威寧鎮總兵。

translations.literal: and broke the timber fort on Milagalamu Mountain: in all these Techeng'e had merit, and he was appointed Regional Commander of Weining in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: and broke the timber fort on Milagalamu Mountain—in each action Techeng'e distinguished himself and was appointed regional commander of Weining in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十二年，上以勳舊世家有世為領侍衛內大臣，因以豐升額遺缺授特成額。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year of Qianlong, because meritorious old families had members who generation after generation served as chief commandant of the imperial guard, the vacancy left by Fengsheng'e was given to Techeng'e.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 42 the emperor noted that eminent old families often supplied successive chief commandants of the imperial guard and gave Techeng'e the post vacated by Fengsheng'e.

sentences.zh: 三遷授禮部尚書，為成都將軍，三攝總督。

translations.literal: After three promotions he was made Minister of Rites, then General of Chengdu, and thrice acted as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: After three further promotions he became Minister of Rites, then General of Chengdu, and three times acted as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 尋除湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was made Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 五十年，歲旱，湖北、江蘇、浙江皆飢，特成額疏請發湖南倉穀賑湖北。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year drought brought famine to Hubei, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang; Techeng'e memorialized requesting grain from Hunan granaries to relieve Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year drought left Hubei, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang hungry; Techeng'e asked to release Hunan granary grain to feed Hubei.

sentences.zh: 有餘平值以糶，使商自四川販米至者，見湖北穀值低，得輸以濟江、浙。

translations.literal: Surplus grain was sold at fair price; merchants bringing rice from Sichuan found Hubei's grain prices low and were able to ship supplies to relieve Jiangsu and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Surplus grain was sold at regulated prices, and merchants hauling rice from Sichuan, seeing lower prices in Hubei, were able to forward supplies to Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 上獎其不分畛域，得大臣體。

translations.literal: The emperor praised him for not distinguishing territorial boundaries and for showing the bearing of a great minister.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him for looking beyond provincial boundaries and acting as a true grand minister should.

sentences.zh: 尋移雲貴總督，以李侍堯代督湖廣。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was transferred to be Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou, and Li Shiyao replaced him as governor of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou, with Li Shiyao replacing him in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 侍堯疏發上年旱飢，孝感民無食，掠富家儲穀；

translations.literal: Shiyao memorialized that because of the previous year's drought and famine the people of Xiaogan had no food and looted the grain stores of wealthy families;
translations.idiomatic: Shiyao reported that after the previous year's drought the people of Xiaogan were starving and raided wealthy families' grain stores;

sentences.zh: 諸生梅調元者，糾眾與抗，生瘞二十三人。

translations.literal: the licentiate Mei Tiaoyuan rallied a crowd to resist, and twenty-three people lost their lives.
translations.idiomatic: licentiate Mei Tiaoyuan rallied a crowd to resist, and twenty-three people were killed.

sentences.zh: 上震怒，逮特成額，籍其家。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly angered, arrested Techeng'e, and confiscated his property.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious, had Techeng'e arrested, and confiscated his estate.

sentences.zh: 旋予副都統銜，充烏什辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was given the rank of vice commander-in-chief and appointed Commissioner for Affairs at Wushi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon given vice commander-in-chief rank and made Commissioner for Affairs at Wushi.

sentences.zh: 又坐在湖廣失察屬吏侵帑、案牘壅積，屢被譴責。

translations.literal: He was also punished for failing in Huguang to detect subordinates' embezzlement of funds and for the backlog of documents, and was repeatedly censured.
translations.idiomatic: He was also blamed for failing in Huguang to catch subordinates' embezzlement and for letting paperwork pile up, and was censured repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 及荊州堤決，复逮下獄論絞，久之，赦。

translations.literal: When the Jingzhou dike broke he was again arrested, imprisoned, and sentenced to strangulation; after a long time he was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jingzhou dike failed he was arrested again, tried for strangulation, and pardoned only after a long interval.

sentences.zh: 授頭等侍衛、烏魯木齊辦事大臣。

translations.literal: He was appointed first-rank bodyguard and Commissioner for Affairs at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: He was made first-rank bodyguard and Commissioner for Affairs at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，自科布多參贊大臣授兵部侍郎，未上，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing, from military assistant at Kobdo he was appointed Vice Minister of War but died before taking office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiaqing he was promoted from military assistant at Kobdo to Vice Minister of War but died before assuming the post.

sentences.zh: 玉保，烏朗罕濟勒門氏，蒙古鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Yu Bao, of the Ulanghan Jilemen clan, was a Bannerman of the Mongol Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Bao belonged to the Ulanghan Jilemen clan and came from the Mongol Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自理籓院筆帖式三遷郎中。

translations.literal: From a clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs he was promoted three times to director.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs he rose through three promotions to director.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年，擢侍郎。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianlong he was promoted to vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 3 he was promoted to vice minister.

sentences.zh: 八年，率準噶爾使者入藏熬茶，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he led Dzungar envoys into Tibet to boil tea and was granted peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he led Dzungar envoys to Tibet for the tea-boiling ceremony and was granted peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 十二年，复率準噶爾使者入藏熬茶，疏言：「前次入藏，自巴延喀喇納木齊圖穆倫至穆魯烏蘇渡口，道甚險，時方秋冬間少雪，行旅尚便。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he again led Dzungar envoys into Tibet to boil tea and memorialized: "On the previous entry into Tibet, from Bayankhara Namuqitumulun to the Muruusu crossing the route was very dangerous; it was late autumn and early winter with little snow, so travel was still tolerable.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 he again led Dzungar envoys to Tibet for the tea ceremony and reported: "On the previous journey from Bayankhara Namuqitumulun to the Muruusu ford the route was treacherous, but as it was late autumn with little snow travel was still manageable.

sentences.zh: 今冬令大雪，擬改道逾哈什哈嶺左巴延喀喇巴山後，自布魯爾仍至穆魯烏蘇渡口。」

translations.literal: This winter there is heavy snow; I propose to change the route by crossing left of Hashaha Ridge behind Bayankhara Mountain, from Buru'er still reaching the Muruusu crossing."
translations.idiomatic: This winter's heavy snow makes a new route advisable: pass left of Hashaha Ridge behind Bayankhara Mountain, from Buru'er still to the Muruusu ford."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The reply approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the change.

sentences.zh: 十六年，遷正黃旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to be commander-in-chief of the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he was made commander-in-chief of the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 十七年，達瓦齊為亂，命偕尚書舒赫德赴北路防邊。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Dawachi rebelled; he was ordered to go with Minister Shuhede to the northern route to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17, when Dawachi rebelled, he was sent with Minister Shuhede to guard the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 十八年，杜爾伯特台吉策淩等來降，命馳赴犒勞。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Torghut taiji Tsewang and others came to surrender; he was ordered to hurry forward to reward them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 Torghut taiji Tsewang and others surrendered, and he was ordered to hurry out and reward them.

sentences.zh: 上以玉保習準噶爾事，命以參贊大臣佐軍事。

translations.literal: Because Yu Bao was versed in Dzungar affairs, the emperor ordered him to serve as military assistant in the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing Yu Bao's expertise in Dzungar affairs, the emperor made him military assistant on the campaign.

sentences.zh: 十九年，輝特台吉阿睦爾撒納來降，復命馳赴犒勞，率以入覲。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year the Khoit taiji Amursana came to surrender; he was again ordered to hurry forward to reward them and led them to audience.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 Khoit taiji Amursana surrendered; Yu Bao was again sent to reward them and escorted them to court.

sentences.zh: 二十年，阿睦爾撒納叛，命仍以侍郎、參贊大臣出北路。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Amursana rebelled; he was ordered to go out on the northern route again as vice minister and military assistant.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20, when Amursana rebelled, he was again sent on the northern route as vice minister and military assistant.

sentences.zh: 師次哈齊克，遣兵至鄂什默納河，收阿睦爾撒納所屬三百餘戶。

translations.literal: The army halted at Haqike; troops were sent to the Eshimona River and more than three hundred households belonging to Amursana were brought in.
translations.idiomatic: The army camped at Haqike and sent troops to the Eshimona River, bringing in more than three hundred of Amursana's households.

sentences.zh: 搜山，獲阿睦爾撒納黨得木齊班咱等。

translations.literal: Mountains were searched and Amursana's partisans Demuqi Banza and others were captured.
translations.idiomatic: A mountain search captured Amursana's followers Demuqi Banza and others.

sentences.zh: 進次安集雅哈，殲阿巴噶齊所屬三百餘戶，圍班雜游牧。

translations.literal: The army advanced to Anjiyaha, destroyed more than three hundred households belonging to Abagaqi, and besieged the Banza nomads.
translations.idiomatic: The army pushed on to Anjiyaha, wiped out more than three hundred of Abagaqi's households, and surrounded the Banza nomads.

sentences.zh: 尋從逆喇嘛達什藏布，並收其妻子。

translations.literal: Soon the rebel lama Dashizangbu was captured together with his wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they captured the rebel lama Dashizangbu along with his wife and children.

sentences.zh: 擢內大臣。

translations.literal: He was promoted to grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to grand minister.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，策楞疏報已獲阿睦爾撒納，行賞，封玉保三等男世襲。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Ce Leng memorialized that Amursana had been captured; rewards were distributed and Yu Bao was ennobled as a third-rank baron with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Ce Leng reported that Amursana had been taken; rewards were handed out and Yu Bao was made a hereditary third-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 玉保獲從賊達永阿，言阿睦爾撒納相距僅一日，玉保執送策楞。

translations.literal: Yu Bao captured the rebel follower Dayong'a, who said Amursana was only one day's march away; Yu Bao seized him and sent him to Ce Leng.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Bao captured Amursana's follower Dayong'a, who said Amursana was only a day away; Yu Bao sent him under guard to Ce Leng.

sentences.zh: 又得從賊烏遜，言阿睦爾撒納方出痘，所部尚有厄魯特兵八千、哈薩克兵三千，亦執送策楞。

translations.literal: He also obtained the rebel follower Wuxun, who said Amursana had just recovered from smallpox and still had eight thousand Olot troops and three thousand Kazakh troops in his following; he too was seized and sent to Ce Leng.
translations.idiomatic: He also took the rebel follower Wuxun, who reported that Amursana had just survived smallpox and still commanded eight thousand Olot and three thousand Kazakh troops; he too was sent to Ce Leng under guard.

sentences.zh: 上責玉保退縮，玉保師復進。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Yu Bao for holding back; Yu Bao's army again advanced.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor censured Yu Bao for shrinking back, and Yu Bao's army pushed forward again.

sentences.zh: 遣諸將烏爾登等追至庫隴癸嶺，得從賊額林沁，言阿睦爾撒納已踰嶺入哈薩克境，引還，次固勒扎。

translations.literal: He dispatched generals including Urden in pursuit to Kulongguiling, captured the rebel follower Elinqin, who said Amursana had already crossed the pass into Kazakh territory; they withdrew and halted at Gulzhah.
translations.idiomatic: He sent generals including Urden in pursuit to Kulongguiling and captured the rebel follower Elinqin, who said Amursana had already crossed into Kazakh territory; the force withdrew and camped at Gulzhah.

sentences.zh: 上怒策楞、玉保不得阿睦爾撒納。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry that Ce Leng and Yu Bao had failed to capture Amursana.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious that Ce Leng and Yu Bao had let Amursana slip away.

sentences.zh: 策楞又疏言玉保馳檄謂阿睦爾撒納即日就擒，無煩大軍深入，因是勒兵未進，遂命並逮詣京師，旋命姑寬之。

translations.literal: Ce Leng again memorialized that Yu Bao had sent an urgent dispatch saying Amursana would be captured that very day and the main army need not push deep; for this reason the army was restrained from advancing; orders were then issued to arrest both and send them to the capital, but soon they were temporarily pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Ce Leng reported again that Yu Bao had sent an urgent dispatch claiming Amursana would be taken that day and the main army need not advance deep; the army was held back, both men were ordered arrested and sent to the capital, and then temporarily pardoned.

sentences.zh: 玉保疏辨未嘗馳檄阻策楞進兵，上謂：「玉保即未阻策楞進兵，阿睦爾撒納脫於誰手？」

translations.literal: Yu Bao memorialized in his defense that he had never sent a dispatch blocking Ce Leng's advance; the emperor said: "Even if Yu Bao did not block Ce Leng's advance, through whose hands did Amursana escape?"
translations.idiomatic: Yu Bao defended himself, saying he had never sent a dispatch to stop Ce Leng's advance; the emperor replied: "Even if Yu Bao did not stop Ce Leng, through whose hands did Amursana escape?"

sentences.zh: 因斥其畏葸欺飾，削男爵，奪參贊大臣，改授領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He was rebuked for timidity and deception; his baronage was stripped, his post as military assistant was removed, and he was reassigned as commander of a detached column.
translations.idiomatic: He was rebuked for cowardice and deceit, stripped of his baronage and military assistant post, and reassigned as commander of a detached column.

sentences.zh: 玉保疏言阿睦爾撒納僅餘從賊二三人，投哈薩克汗阿布賚，正督兵往索。

translations.literal: Yu Bao memorialized that Amursana had only two or three rebel followers left and had fled to Kazakh Khan Ablai; he was directing troops to demand his surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Bao reported that Amursana had only two or three followers left and had taken refuge with Kazakh Khan Ablai, and that he was leading troops to demand his surrender.

sentences.zh: 上以玉保明知叛賊孑身無助，始直前追逐，斥其取巧。

translations.literal: The emperor said Yu Bao had clearly known the rebel was alone and helpless before boldly pressing the pursuit, and rebuked him for taking the easy way.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said Yu Bao had clearly known the rebel was alone and powerless before pressing the pursuit, and rebuked him for playing it safe.

sentences.zh: 命尚書阿里袞詣軍逮策楞，並諭：「玉保已率兵向哈薩克，免其罪，未行則並逮。」

translations.literal: Minister Aligun was ordered to go to the army to arrest Ce Leng, and an edict stated: "Yu Bao has already led troops toward the Kazakhs; his offense is pardoned—but if he has not marched, arrest him as well."
translations.idiomatic: Minister Aligun was sent to the army to arrest Ce Leng, with orders: "If Yu Bao has already led troops toward the Kazakhs, his offense is pardoned; if he has not marched, arrest him as well."

sentences.zh: 尋達爾黨阿疏報玉保師已臨哈薩克，命授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: Soon Da Erdang'a memorialized that Yu Bao's army had already reached the Kazakhs; Yu Bao was ordered given the rank of first-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Da Erdang'a reported that Yu Bao's army had reached the Kazakhs, and Yu Bao was granted the rank of first-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 旋以師久次不得阿睦爾撒納，命仍逮治，與策楞同送京師。

translations.literal: Soon, because the army had camped for a long time without capturing Amursana, orders went out again for his arrest and trial; he was sent to the capital together with Ce Leng.
translations.idiomatic: When the army lingered for months without capturing Amursana, he was again ordered arrested and sent to the capital together with Ce Leng.

sentences.zh: 道死。

translations.literal: He died on the way.
translations.idiomatic: He died en route.

sentences.zh: 達爾黨阿，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，理籓院尚書阿靈阿次子。

translations.literal: Da Erdang'a, of the Niohuru clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and the second son of Alin'a, Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Da Erdang'a belonged to the Niohuru clan, came from the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner, and was the second son of Alin'a, Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 初襲曾祖額亦都一等子爵，累官吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He first inherited his great-grandfather Ejidu's first-rank viscountcy and rose through successive posts to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He first inherited his great-grandfather Ejidu's first-rank viscountcy and rose through successive posts to Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 訥親得罪，請從軍。

translations.literal: When Neqin fell from favor, he requested to join the army.
translations.idiomatic: When Neqin fell from favor, he asked to join the campaign.

sentences.zh: 師還，加太子少保。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was made Junior Guardian to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was made Junior Guardian to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十九年，出為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Qianlong he was appointed General of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 19 he was appointed General of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 策楞得罪，命襲封二等公。

translations.literal: When Ce Leng fell from favor he was ordered to inherit the title as a second-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: When Ce Leng fell from favor he was ordered to inherit the title as a second-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 是年十二月，上用阿睦爾撒納討達瓦齊，以班第為定北將軍，授達爾黨阿參贊大臣。

translations.literal: That December the emperor employed Amursana against Dawachi; Bandi was made General for the Pacification of the North and Da Erdang'a was appointed military assistant.
translations.idiomatic: That December the emperor used Amursana against Dawachi, made Bandi General for the Pacification of the North, and appointed Da Erdang'a military assistant.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月，命將索倫、巴爾呼兵詣軍。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year he was ordered to lead Solon and Barhu troops to join the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twentieth year he was ordered to lead Solon and Barhu troops to join the army.

sentences.zh: 五月，定伊犁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Yili was secured.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yili was taken.

sentences.zh: 師還，命協辦大學士。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was ordered to serve as associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was made associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 及阿睦爾撒納叛，授定邊左副將軍，偕參贊大臣哈達哈，出北路，率師逐捕。

translations.literal: When Amursana rebelled he was appointed Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier; together with military assistant Ha Daha he marched out on the northern route to lead troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: When Amursana rebelled he was made Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier and, with military assistant Ha Daha, marched out on the northern route to hunt him down.

sentences.zh: 十月，改授右副將軍，出西路，而以哈達哈當北路。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was reassigned as Right Deputy General and sent out on the western route, while Ha Daha took the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was reassigned as Right Deputy General for the western route while Ha Daha took the northern route.

sentences.zh: 十二月，復以將印授扎拉豐阿，達爾黨阿仍為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the general's seal was again given to Zhalafeng'a; Da Erdang'a remained military assistant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the general's seal was given again to Zhalafeng'a while Da Erdang'a remained military assistant.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月，又以鄂勒哲依、薩賴爾同掌將印。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-first year O'lecheyi and Salai'er were also given joint command of the general's seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-first year O'lecheyi and Salai'er were also given joint command of the general's seal.

sentences.zh: 達爾黨阿帥師至珠勒都斯迎薩賴爾。

translations.literal: Da Erdang'a led his army to Zhuledusi to welcome Salai'er.
translations.idiomatic: Da Erdang'a led his army to Zhuledusi to welcome Salai'er.

sentences.zh: 及策楞報獲阿睦爾撒納，達爾黨阿亦賜雙眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: When Ce Leng reported the capture of Amursana, Da Erdang'a was also granted double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: When Ce Leng reported Amursana's capture, Da Erdang'a was also granted double-eyed peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 尋自特訥格爾赴安集海，分兵略唐古特游牧。

translations.literal: Soon he moved from Teneger to Anjiha and sent detachments to raid Tangut nomads.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he moved from Teneger to Anjiha and sent detachments to raid Tangut pastures.

sentences.zh: 旋以阿睦爾撒納竄入哈薩克，上命西路專任達爾黨阿，北路專任哈達哈，督兵壓哈薩克境，使擒阿睦爾撒納以獻。

translations.literal: Soon, because Amursana had fled into Kazakh territory, the emperor ordered Da Erdang'a to have sole charge of the western route and Ha Daha of the northern route, directing troops to press the Kazakh border and have Amursana seized and presented.
translations.idiomatic: When Amursana fled into Kazakh territory, the emperor put the western route solely under Da Erdang'a and the northern route under Ha Daha, ordering them to press the Kazakh frontier and seize Amursana.

sentences.zh: 五月，复授右副將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was again appointed Right Deputy General.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was again appointed Right Deputy General.

sentences.zh: 時策楞駐登努勒台，令達爾黨阿還師。

translations.literal: At that time Ce Leng was stationed at Dengnuletai and ordered Da Erdang'a to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: Ce Leng was then stationed at Dengnuletai and ordered Da Erdang'a to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 達爾黨阿不從，上即解策楞定西將軍以命達爾黨阿。

translations.literal: Da Erdang'a refused; the emperor immediately removed Ce Leng as General for the Pacification of the West and gave the command to Da Erdang'a.
translations.idiomatic: Da Erdang'a refused, and the emperor at once removed Ce Leng as General for the Pacification of the West and gave the command to Da Erdang'a.

sentences.zh: 八月，師次雅爾拉，哈薩克汗阿布賚遣頭人和集博爾根率四千騎分二隊從阿睦爾撒納走魯臘，而自率千餘騎西行，會於毫阿臘克山下。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the army halted at Yalira; Kazakh Khan Ablai sent the chieftain Hoqibolgen with four thousand horsemen in two columns to follow Amursana toward Lulai, while he himself led more than a thousand horsemen westward; they met at the foot of Hao'alake Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the army halted at Yalira; Kazakh Khan Ablai sent chieftain Hoqibolgen with four thousand horsemen in two columns to follow Amursana toward Lulai while he himself led more than a thousand westward; they met below Hao'alake Mountain.

sentences.zh: 達爾黨阿師至，遇和集博爾根前隊，自山谷中誘使出，突其中堅，斬五百七十餘級，獲頭人楚魯克。

translations.literal: When Da Erdang'a's army arrived it met Hoqibolgen's vanguard; luring them out from the valley it struck the center, killed more than five hundred seventy, and captured the chieftain Chuluke.
translations.idiomatic: When Da Erdang'a's army arrived it met Hoqibolgen's vanguard, lured them out of the valley, broke their center, killed more than five hundred seventy, and captured chieftain Chuluke.

sentences.zh: 逐敵至努喇，遇和集博爾根後隊，复戰陷陣，得其纛，斬三百四十餘級。

translations.literal: Pursuing the enemy to Nula, they met Hoqibolgen's rearguard; fighting again they broke the enemy line, seized his banner standard, and killed more than three hundred forty.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the enemy to Nula they met Hoqibolgen's rearguard, broke through again, seized his banner, and killed more than three hundred forty.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納部宰桑言阿睦爾撒納易藍纛以戰，戰敗，易服遁。

translations.literal: A zaisang of Amursana's following said Amursana had exchanged his blue banner standard to fight; after defeat he changed clothes and fled.
translations.idiomatic: A zaisang in Amursana's party said Amursana had swapped his blue banner to join the fight, then changed clothes and fled after defeat.

sentences.zh: 哈達哈亦擊破阿布賚軍，獲頭人昭華什。

translations.literal: Ha Daha also defeated Ablai's army and captured the chieftain Zhaohuashi.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Daha also defeated Ablai's army and captured chieftain Zhaohuashi.

sentences.zh: 兩軍合，遣楚魯克、昭華什還諭其渠。

translations.literal: The two armies joined and sent Chuluke and Zhaohuashi back to instruct their leaders.
translations.idiomatic: The two armies joined and sent Chuluke and Zhaohuashi back to convey terms to their chiefs.

sentences.zh: 時阿睦爾撒納走不過一二里許，遇楚魯克等，使還報偽為哈薩克頭人語，待其汗阿布賚至，且執阿睦爾撒納以獻。

translations.literal: At that time Amursana had fled no more than a li or two; meeting Chuluke and the others, he had them return with a message falsely speaking as Kazakh chieftains, saying they would wait until their khan Ablai arrived and would seize Amursana and present him.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana had fled only a li or two when he met Chuluke and the others and sent them back with a message in the guise of Kazakh chieftains, saying they would wait for Khan Ablai and seize Amursana to present him.

sentences.zh: 達爾黨阿信之，按兵以待。

translations.literal: Da Erdang'a believed them and held the army in place awaiting their word.
translations.idiomatic: Da Erdang'a believed them and held his army in place to wait.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納從容捆載去。

translations.literal: Amursana leisurely loaded up his goods and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana calmly packed up his belongings and got away.

sentences.zh: 上聞不得阿睦爾撒納，命繳雙眼翎，召還京師，罷協辦大學士。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard that Amursana had not been captured, he ordered the double-eyed feathers surrendered, Da Erdang'a recalled to the capital, and his associate grand secretary post removed.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that Amursana had escaped, the emperor ordered Da Erdang'a to surrender his double-eyed feathers, recalled him to the capital, and removed him as associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 二十二年二月，奪爵，左授正白旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-second year his title was stripped and he was demoted to vice commander-in-chief of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-second year he was stripped of his title and demoted to vice commander-in-chief of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 八月，軍中俘阿睦爾撒納從子達什，策楞檻致京師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Amursana's nephew Dashi was captured in camp and Ce Leng sent him to the capital in the cangue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Amursana's nephew Dashi was captured in camp and Ce Leng sent him to the capital in the cangue.

sentences.zh: 上始聞達爾黨阿、哈達哈緩追逸賊狀，俱奪官，發熱河披甲。

translations.literal: The emperor first learned how Da Erdang'a and Ha Daha had pursued the fugitive rebel halfheartedly; both were stripped of office and sent to Rehe as common soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor first learned how halfheartedly Da Erdang'a and Ha Daha had pursued the fugitive rebel; both were stripped of rank and sent to Rehe as common soldiers.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，授三等侍衛，率西安駐防兵赴軍，師有功，進二等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was appointed third-rank bodyguard, led Xi'an garrison troops to join the army; the army had merit and he was advanced to second-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was made third-rank bodyguard, led Xi'an garrison troops to the front, and was raised to second-rank bodyguard when the army distinguished itself.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 哈達哈，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人，黑龍江將軍傅爾丹子。

translations.literal: Ha Daha, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner and the son of Fu Erdan, General of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Daha belonged to the Guwalgiya clan, came from the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner, and was the son of Fu Erdan, General of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹初襲曾祖費英東二等信勇公，乾隆元年，追論失律罪，黜，以哈達哈襲。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan had first inherited his great-grandfather Feiyingdong's second-rank meritorious brave duke title; in the first year of Qianlong a retrospective judgment on military misconduct led to his dismissal, and Ha Daha inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan had first inherited his great-grandfather Feiyingdong's second-rank meritorious brave duke title; in Qianlong year 1 a retrospective judgment for military misconduct removed him, and Ha Daha inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 是時哈達哈已自侍衛累遷領侍衛內大臣，兼勳舊佐領。

translations.literal: At that time Ha Daha had already risen from bodyguard through successive posts to chief commandant of the imperial guard, concurrently holding a meritorious old banner company captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: By then Ha Daha had already risen from bodyguard to chief commandant of the imperial guard while also holding a meritorious old banner company captaincy.

sentences.zh: 既，襲爵，复遷鑲紅旗滿洲都統、工部尚書，加太子少保，署兵部尚書、步軍統領。

translations.literal: After inheriting the title he was again transferred to commander-in-chief of the Manchu Bordered Red Banner and Minister of Works, made Junior Guardian to the Heir Apparent, and served concurrently as acting Minister of War and metropolitan commandant.
translations.idiomatic: After inheriting the title he became commander-in-chief of the Manchu Bordered Red Banner and Minister of Works, was made Junior Guardian to the Heir Apparent, and served concurrently as acting Minister of War and metropolitan commandant.

sentences.zh: 十九年，師討達瓦齊，授參贊大臣，佐定北將軍班第出北路。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, when the army campaigned against Dawachi, he was appointed military assistant and assisted General for the Pacification of the North Bandi on the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, during the campaign against Dawachi, he was made military assistant to General for the Pacification of the North Bandi on the northern route.

sentences.zh: 尋改領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Soon he was changed to commander of a detached column.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made commander of a detached column.

sentences.zh: 二十年，達瓦齊就俘。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Dawachi was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Dawachi was taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 再出師討阿睦爾撒納，复授參贊大臣，佐定邊左副將軍達爾黨阿出北路。

translations.literal: The army marched out again against Amursana; he was again appointed military assistant and assisted Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier Da Erdang'a on the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: The army marched out again against Amursana; he was again made military assistant to Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier Da Erdang'a on the northern route.

sentences.zh: 哈達哈請將索倫、喀爾喀兵為前鋒，上獎其奮勉。

translations.literal: Ha Daha requested that Solon and Khalkha troops serve as vanguard; the emperor praised his zeal.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Daha asked that Solon and Khalkha troops serve as vanguard, and the emperor praised his zeal.

sentences.zh: 尋命代達爾黨阿為定邊左副將軍當北路，移軍布延圖。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to replace Da Erdang'a as Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier on the northern route and moved the army to Buyantu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to replace Da Erdang'a as Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier on the northern route and moved his army to Buyantu.

sentences.zh: 南自伊克斯淖爾，北至烏哈爾喀碩及烏里雅蘇台、劄卜堪諸形勝地，皆分兵列戍。

translations.literal: From Yiks Lake in the south to Uharkashuo and the strategic points of Uliastai and Zhabukan in the north, troops were stationed in detachments all along the line.
translations.idiomatic: From Yiks Lake in the south to Uharkashuo, Uliastai, Zhabukan, and other strategic points in the north, he posted troops in detachments along the whole line.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，命自阿爾泰進兵，詔以北路專任哈達哈。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was ordered to advance from the Altai; an edict put the northern route solely under Ha Daha's charge.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was ordered to advance from the Altai, and an edict put the northern route solely under his command.

sentences.zh: 特楞古特宰桑敦多克、固爾班和卓等與我師遇，偽請降。

translations.literal: The Telengut zaisang Dundok, Gurban Khoja, and others met our army and falsely requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Telengut zaisang Dundok, Gurban Khoja, and others met our army and feigned surrender.

sentences.zh: 哈達哈察其詐，斬敦多克，縶固爾班和卓等，殪其眾。

translations.literal: Ha Daha detected the ruse, executed Dundok, bound Gurban Khoja and the others, and destroyed their following.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Daha saw through the ruse, executed Dundok, bound Gurban Khoja and the others, and wiped out their followers.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其勇，再授領侍衛內大臣，賜雙眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: The emperor commended his bravery, again appointed him chief commandant of the imperial guard, and granted double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his bravery, again made him chief commandant of the imperial guard, and granted double-eyed peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 師至嵩哈薩拉克山，遇哈薩克汗阿布賚擁眾自巴顏山西行，與戰，敗之。

translations.literal: The army reached Songhasalak Mountain and met Kazakh Khan Ablai leading a large force westward from Bayan Mountain; they fought and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: The army reached Songhasalak Mountain, met Kazakh Khan Ablai leading a large force west from Bayan Mountain, fought him, and won.

sentences.zh: 復遣諸將瑚爾起、鄂博什、奇徹布等追擊，斬百餘級，獲馬二百。

translations.literal: Generals Hu'erqi, Eboshi, Qichebu, and others were again dispatched in pursuit; more than a hundred were killed and two hundred horses taken.
translations.idiomatic: He again sent generals Hu'erqi, Eboshi, Qichebu, and others in pursuit, killing more than a hundred and capturing two hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 哈達哈不知阿布賚在軍，未窮追；

translations.literal: Ha Daha did not know Ablai was with the army and did not pursue to the end;
translations.idiomatic: Ha Daha did not know Ablai was with the army and failed to pursue to the end;

sentences.zh: 而達爾黨阿與阿睦爾撒納遇，戰既勝，縱使脫去。

translations.literal: while Da Erdang'a encountered Amursana, and after winning the battle let him escape.
translations.idiomatic: while Da Erdang'a met Amursana, won the battle, and then let him get away.

sentences.zh: 兩軍合，引還。

translations.literal: The two armies joined and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The two armies joined and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 奪雙眼孔雀翎，命以參贊大臣屯科布多。

translations.literal: His double-eyed peacock feathers were taken; he was ordered to garrison at Kobdo as military assistant.
translations.idiomatic: His double-eyed peacock feathers were taken and he was ordered to garrison at Kobdo as military assistant.

sentences.zh: 尋論失阿布賚罪，奪爵，罷領侍衛內大臣，左授兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was judged guilty of letting Ablai escape; his title was stripped, he was removed as chief commandant of the imperial guard, and demoted to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was judged guilty of letting Ablai escape, stripped of his title and post as chief commandant of the imperial guard, and demoted to Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 旋就進尚書，徙屯烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to minister and transferred his garrison to Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to minister and moved his garrison to Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 二十二年八月，詔罪狀達爾黨阿、哈達哈，謂：「二臣皆勳舊子孫，襲爵專閫，而因循觀望，坐失軍機若此。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-second year an edict enumerated the offenses of Da Erdang'a and Ha Daha, saying: "Both ministers are descendants of meritorious old families who inherited titles and held sole command, yet they dragged their feet and watched from the sidelines, thus throwing away military opportunities as they did."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-second year an edict listed the offenses of Da Erdang'a and Ha Daha: "Both are descendants of meritorious old families who inherited titles and held sole command, yet they dragged their feet and watched from the sidelines, throwing away military opportunities as they did."

sentences.zh: 盡奪其官，發熱河披甲。

translations.literal: All their offices were stripped and they were sent to Rehe as common soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: All their offices were stripped and they were sent to Rehe as common soldiers.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，與達爾黨阿同授三等侍衛從軍，同進二等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he and Da Erdang'a were alike appointed third-rank bodyguards to follow the army and alike advanced to second-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he and Da Erdang'a were both made third-rank bodyguards on campaign and both raised to second-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 子哈寧阿，自藍翎侍衛累遷寧夏副都統。

translations.literal: His son Haning'a rose from a bodyguard with blue insignia through successive posts to vice commander-in-chief of Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: His son Haning'a rose from a bodyguard with blue insignia to vice commander-in-chief of Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 哈達哈為定邊左副將軍，哈寧阿為領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Ha Daha was Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier and Haning'a was commander of a detached column.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Daha served as Left Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier while Haning'a served as commander of a detached column.

sentences.zh: 尋命以參贊大臣佐定西將軍達爾黨阿出西路。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to serve as military assistant to General for the Pacification of the West Da Erdang'a on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to serve as military assistant to General for the Pacification of the West Da Erdang'a on the western route.

sentences.zh: 旋令詣伊犁佐定邊右副將軍兆惠。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to go to Yili to assist Right Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier Zhao Hui.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to Yili to assist Right Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier Zhao Hui.

sentences.zh: 兆惠困濟爾哈朗，力戰突圍出，哈寧阿與焉，予三等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: When Zhao Hui was trapped at Jierhalang, Haning'a was among those who fought hard to break out; he was granted a third-rank commandant of light chariots with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Hui was trapped at Jierhalang, Haning'a was among those who fought their way out and was granted a hereditary third-rank commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 又從兆惠擊巴雅爾，功最，賜玉韘、荷包、鼻煙壺。

translations.literal: He again followed Zhao Hui against Bayar and distinguished himself most; he was granted a jade thumb ring, purse, and snuff bottle.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Zhao Hui against Bayar and distinguished himself above all others; he was given a jade thumb ring, purse, and snuff bottle.

sentences.zh: 哈達哈奪爵，以哈寧阿襲，擢鑲黃旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: When Ha Daha's title was stripped Haning'a inherited it and was promoted to commander-in-chief of the Han Army Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Ha Daha lost his title Haning'a inherited it and was promoted to commander-in-chief of the Han Army Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十三年，复授參贊大臣，佐靖逆將軍雅爾哈善討霍集占。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Qianlong he was again appointed military assistant to assist General for the Pacification of Rebellion Ya Erhashan against Khoja Jahan.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 23 he was again made military assistant to General for the Pacification of Rebellion Ya Erhashan against Khoja Jahan.

sentences.zh: 圍庫車，霍集占脫去，與雅爾哈善同逮送京師。

translations.literal: When Khoja Jahan escaped during the siege of Kuche, Haning'a was arrested and sent to the capital together with Ya Erhashan.
translations.idiomatic: During the siege of Kuche Khoja Jahan escaped, and Haning'a was arrested and sent to the capital together with Ya Erhashan.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月，雅爾哈善棄市。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year Ya Erhashan was executed by decapitation in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year Ya Erhashan was executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 上以哈寧阿為參贊，責薄於將軍，又念濟爾哈朗力戰有勞，命繫獄待秋決。

translations.literal: Because Haning'a was a military assistant with lighter responsibility than the general, yet also mindful of his hard fighting at Jierhalang, the emperor ordered him imprisoned awaiting autumn execution.
translations.idiomatic: Because Haning'a was only a military assistant with less responsibility than the general, yet mindful of his hard fighting at Jierhalang, the emperor ordered him imprisoned awaiting autumn execution.

sentences.zh: 十一月，富德師至巴達克山，遣使令縛送霍集占。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Fu De's army reached Badakhshan and sent envoys ordering Khoja Jahan bound and sent in.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Fu De's army reached Badakhshan and sent envoys to demand Khoja Jahan bound and delivered.

sentences.zh: 上以達爾黨阿、哈達哈皆在軍，不自奮請行，詔詰責，因言：「哈寧阿秋讞本當決，哈達哈稍有事效，尚當寬宥，今豈可曲貸？

translations.literal: The emperor, noting that Da Erdang'a and Ha Daha were both in the army yet had not themselves urgently volunteered for service, issued a rebuking edict saying: "Haning'a's autumn sentence should properly be death; had Ha Daha achieved some merit one might still have pardoned him—how now can one show undue leniency?
translations.idiomatic: Noting that Da Erdang'a and Ha Daha were both in the army yet had not volunteered for service, the emperor issued a rebuking edict: "Haning'a's autumn sentence should be death; had Ha Daha achieved some merit one might still have pardoned him—how now can leniency be shown?

sentences.zh: 重念費英東勳勞，不忍刑諸市。」

translations.literal: Out of deep regard for Feiyingdong's meritorious service, he could not bear to execute him in the marketplace."
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of Feiyingdong's meritorious service, he could not bear to execute him in public."

sentences.zh: 命賜自盡，且令馳諭哈達哈，哈達哈已先以十月卒於軍。

translations.literal: Haning'a was ordered granted suicide by edict, and Ha Daha was to be urgently informed—but Ha Daha had already died in camp in the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Haning'a was ordered granted suicide, and Ha Daha was to be urgently informed—but Ha Daha had already died in camp in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 永常，董鄂氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Yongchang, of the Donggo clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang belonged to the Donggo clan and came from the Manchu Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自三等侍衛累遷鑲紅旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: From third-rank bodyguard he rose through successive posts to commander-in-chief of the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: From third-rank bodyguard he rose through successive posts to commander-in-chief of the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五年，命如安西按事，即授安西提督，屯哈密，賜孔雀翎、紅絨結頂冠。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qianlong he was ordered to Anxi to investigate affairs and was immediately appointed Military Commander of Anxi, stationed at Hami, and granted peacock feathers and a red velvet hat knob.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 5 he was sent to Anxi to investigate affairs, immediately made Military Commander of Anxi, stationed at Hami, and granted peacock feathers and a red velvet hat knob.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was appointed governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 羅田民馬潮柱為亂，討平之。

translations.literal: When the Luotian commoner Ma Chaozhu raised a rebellion, he suppressed it.
translations.idiomatic: When the Luotian commoner Ma Chaozhu rebelled, he put the disturbance down.

sentences.zh: 十八年，上將徵準噶爾，命為欽差大臣，駐安西。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, as the emperor was about to campaign against the Dzungars, [Yongchang] was appointed Imperial Commissioner and stationed at Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, as the emperor prepared to campaign against the Dzungars, Yongchang was made Imperial Commissioner and stationed at Anxi.

sentences.zh: 旋移陝甘總督，加太子少保。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu and given the rank of Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu and given the rank of Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 輝特台吉阿睦爾撒納來降，言達瓦齊昏暴。

translations.literal: The Choros taiji Amursana came to surrender, reporting that Dawachi was tyrannical and violent.
translations.idiomatic: Choros taiji Amursana surrendered, reporting that Dawachi was tyrannical and violent.

sentences.zh: 上決策用兵，召永常詣京師，諭行軍機宜，遂以內大臣授定西將軍。

translations.literal: The emperor decided on war, summoned Yongchang to the capital to instruct him on military operations, and then appointed him General for the Pacification of the West with the rank of imperial minister.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor decided on war, summoned Yongchang to the capital to instruct him in military operations, and then made him General for the Pacification of the West with the rank of imperial minister.

sentences.zh: 時上倚阿睦爾撒納及來降宰桑薩賴爾取達瓦齊，以阿睦爾撒納副定北將軍班第出北路，以薩賴爾副永常出西路，仍諭阿睦爾撒納、薩賴爾為軍鋒，敕永常督軍鋒先發。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor relied on Amursana and the surrendered zaisang Salai'er to take Dawachi; Amursana was made deputy to General for the Pacification of the North Bandi on the northern route, Salai'er deputy to Yongchang on the western route; they were still directed to serve as the army's vanguard, and Yongchang was ordered to supervise the vanguard in advancing first.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then relied on Amursana and the surrendered zaisang Salai'er to take Dawachi; Amursana was made deputy to General for the Pacification of the North Bandi on the northern route and Salai'er deputy to Yongchang on the western route, both directed to serve as the army's vanguard while Yongchang was ordered to supervise the vanguard in advancing first.

sentences.zh: 永常令諸道軍兼程並進，上責其誤。

translations.literal: Yongchang ordered the various columns to march together at forced pace; the emperor rebuked the mistake.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang ordered every column to march together at forced pace, and the emperor rebuked the error.

sentences.zh: 永常師次巴里坤，命還肅州。

translations.literal: When Yongchang's army halted at Barkol, he was ordered back to Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongchang's army halted at Barkol, he was ordered back to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 永常還督餉，有所計畫，上皆不謂然。

translations.literal: Yongchang returned to supervise supplies and made various plans, none of which the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang returned to oversee supplies and proposed various plans, none of which the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 師定伊犁，俘達瓦齊，詔責：「永常但知師行糧隨，沾沾議接濟。

translations.literal: When the army secured Yili and captured Dawachi, an edict rebuked [him]: "Yongchang knew only that the army marches as grain follows, and clung pedantically to talk of relief supplies.
translations.idiomatic: When the army secured Yili and captured Dawachi, an edict rebuked him: "Yongchang knew only that the army marches as grain follows, and clung pedantically to talk of relief supplies.

sentences.zh: 今功已成，何慮糧不足？

translations.literal: Now that victory is won, why worry that grain will be insufficient?
translations.idiomatic: Now that victory is won, why worry that grain will be insufficient?

sentences.zh: 因糧於敵，從來勝算。

translations.literal: Taking grain from the enemy has always been the winning calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Taking grain from the enemy has always been the winning calculation.

sentences.zh: 如永常奏，展轉挽運，動逾數十日，庸有濟乎？」

translations.literal: If one followed Yongchang's memorials, relay transport would take more than several tens of days — how could that avail?"
translations.idiomatic: If one followed Yongchang's memorials, relay transport would take more than several tens of days — how could that avail?"

sentences.zh: 因左授吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was then demoted to Left Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was then demoted to Left Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納叛，犯伊犁，永常師左次，上責其怯懦，罷內大臣、定西將軍，以副都統銜為參贊。

translations.literal: When Amursana rebelled and attacked Yili, Yongchang's army camped to one side; the emperor rebuked his cowardice, removed him as imperial minister and General for the Pacification of the West, and made him military assistant with the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: When Amursana rebelled and attacked Yili, Yongchang's army held to one side; the emperor rebuked his cowardice, stripped him of his posts as imperial minister and General for the Pacification of the West, and made him military assistant with the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 厄魯特諸台吉有不從阿睦爾撒納叛者，宰桑扎木參等率數千人詣永常請附屯。

translations.literal: Among the Olot taiji who would not follow Amursana in rebellion, zaisang Zhamu Can and others led several thousand men to Yongchang requesting to attach and settle.
translations.idiomatic: Among the Olot taiji who refused to follow Amursana in rebellion, zaisang Zhamu Can and others led several thousand men to Yongchang to request attachment and settlement.

sentences.zh: 永常疑其詐，挾宰桑為質，兼程卻走，恐賊躡其後，徵策楞赴援，並檄阿敏道引還，同駐巴里坤。

translations.literal: Yongchang suspected a ruse, took the zaisang as hostages, and retreated at forced pace; fearing the rebels would follow, he summoned Ce Leng to aid him and also ordered Amindao to withdraw; together they encamped at Barkol.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang suspected a ruse, took the zaisang as hostages, and retreated at forced pace; fearing pursuit, he summoned Ce Leng to his aid and ordered Amindao to withdraw as well; together they encamped at Barkol.

sentences.zh: 上命奪官逮京師，行至臨潼，道卒。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered his rank stripped and him arrested and sent to the capital; on the road at Lintong he died en route.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered his rank stripped and him arrested and sent to the capital; on the road at Lintong he died en route.

sentences.zh: 仍籍其家，戍其子拉林。

translations.literal: His household was still registered for confiscation and his son Lalin was sent to garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: His household was still registered for confiscation and his son Lalin was sent to garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 覺羅雅爾哈善，字蔚文，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Aisin Gioro Ya Erhashan, courtesy name Weiwen, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Aisin Gioro Ya Erhashan, courtesy name Weiwen, came from the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年繙譯舉人，自內閣中書四遷，乾隆三年，授通政使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng he passed the translation examinations; promoted four times from Secretariat secretary, and in the third year of Qianlong was appointed Commissioner of the Transmission Office.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 3 he passed the translation examinations, rose four ranks from Secretariat secretary, and in Qianlong year 3 was appointed Commissioner of the Transmission Office.

sentences.zh: 御史邱玖華疏論九卿議事不公，別疏請錄用賢良祠大臣子孫。

translations.literal: Censor Qiu Jiuhua memorialized that the Nine Ministers deliberated unfairly, and in a separate memorial requested that descendants of ministers in the Hall of Worthies be employed.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Qiu Jiuhua memorialized that the Nine Ministers deliberated unfairly and, in a separate memorial, requested that descendants of ministers in the Hall of Worthies be employed.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善劾玖華為原任侍郎勵宗萬門生，宗萬祖杜訥為賢良祠大臣，玖華劾九卿議事不公，示剛正，實為起宗萬地。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan impeached Jiuhua as a disciple of the former vice minister Li Zongwan; Zongwan's ancestor Du Ne was a minister in the Hall of Worthies; Jiuhua's impeachment of the Nine Ministers' unfair deliberations was a show of stern uprightness, but in truth aimed to restore Zongwan.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan impeached Jiuhua as a disciple of the former vice minister Li Zongwan; Zongwan's ancestor Du Ne was a minister in the Hall of Worthies, and Jiuhua's attack on the Nine Ministers' unfair deliberations was a show of stern uprightness that in truth aimed to restore Zongwan.

sentences.zh: 上謂：「錄用賢良祠大臣子孫，不過虛銜微秩，視其材可用然後用之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Employing descendants of Hall of Worthies ministers is no more than empty titles and minor ranks; one uses them only when their talent proves suitable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Employing descendants of Hall of Worthies ministers is no more than empty titles and minor ranks; one uses them only when their talent proves suitable.

sentences.zh: 豈有嘗為侍郎獲罪因賢良祠大臣子孫而輒起者？

translations.literal: How could one who had been vice minister, punished for crime, be immediately restored because he was a descendant of a Hall of Worthies minister?
translations.idiomatic: How could one who had been vice minister and punished for crime be immediately restored because he was a descendant of a Hall of Worthies minister?

sentences.zh: 勵宗萬雖愚，計不出此。

translations.literal: Li Zongwan may be foolish, but he would not scheme thus.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongwan may be foolish, but he would not scheme thus.

sentences.zh: 玖華所論九卿議事不公，切中時弊。

translations.literal: Jiuhua's criticism of the Nine Ministers' unfair deliberations hit squarely on the age's abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Jiuhua's criticism of the Nine Ministers' unfair deliberations hit squarely on the age's abuses.

sentences.zh: 諸臣見之，宜深自儆省。

translations.literal: The ministers who read it ought to reflect deeply and warn themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers who read it ought to reflect deeply and warn themselves.

sentences.zh: 若遷怒建言者，是為不知恥！」

translations.literal: If one redirects anger at the man who offered advice, that is shamelessness!"
translations.idiomatic: If one redirects anger at the man who offered advice, that is shamelessness!"

sentences.zh: 命解雅爾哈善任。

translations.literal: He ordered Ya Erhashan dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Ya Erhashan dismissed from office.
