sentences.zh: 令莊親王允祿、平郡王福彭會大學士以下嚴鞫，雅爾哈善言語得之右通政陳履平，因請皆奪官。

translations.literal: Prince Zhuang Yunlu and Prince Ping Fupeng were ordered to join grand secretaries and those below in a strict interrogation; Ya Erhashan said he had learned the words from Right Commissioner of Transmission Chen Lüping, and therefore requested that both be stripped of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhuang Yunlu and Prince Ping Fupeng were ordered to join grand secretaries and those below in a strict interrogation; Ya Erhashan said he had learned the words from Right Commissioner of Transmission Chen Lüping and therefore requested that both be stripped of rank.

sentences.zh: 上責王大臣議不當，命奪雅爾哈善官，履平下吏議。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked the princes and ministers for improper deliberation, ordered Ya Erhashan stripped of rank, and referred Lüping to officials for judgment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked the princes and ministers for improper deliberation, stripped Ya Erhashan of rank, and referred Lüping to officials for judgment.

sentences.zh: 四年，特起四川龍安知府。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was specially recalled as prefect of Long'an in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was specially recalled as prefect of Long'an in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 五年，以憂去。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he left office in mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he left office in mourning.

sentences.zh: 六年，授江南松江知府，移蘇州知府。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed prefect of Songjiang in Jiangnan and transferred to prefect of Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was appointed prefect of Songjiang in Jiangnan and transferred to prefect of Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，遷福建汀漳道。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was promoted to intendant of Tingzhang in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was promoted to intendant of Tingzhang in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善在松江、蘇州皆有聲績，其去，民思之。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan won reputation and achievement at Songjiang and Suzhou; when he left, the people missed him.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan won reputation and achievement at Songjiang and Suzhou, and when he left the people missed him.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以福建按察使署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, as Fujian provincial surveillance commissioner he served as acting governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, as Fujian provincial surveillance commissioner, he served as acting governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 上元民毀制錢，雅爾哈善論如律，復以數少乞原，上責其寬縱，命奪職留任。

translations.literal: On the Shangyuan Festival commoners destroyed standard coin; Ya Erhashan judged according to law, then again pleaded leniency because the number was small; the emperor rebuked his excessive leniency and ordered him stripped of rank but kept in post.
translations.idiomatic: On the Shangyuan Festival commoners destroyed standard coin; Ya Erhashan judged according to law, then pleaded leniency because the number was small; the emperor rebuked his excessive leniency and stripped him of rank but kept him in post.

sentences.zh: 十五年，雅爾哈善議經徵未完不及一分知縣許惟枚等，皆劾罷。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Ya Erhashan judged district magistrates including Xu Weimei who had failed to complete regular tax collection by less than one percent; all were impeached and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Ya Erhashan judged district magistrates including Xu Weimei who had failed to complete regular tax collection by less than one percent, and all were impeached and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 總督黃廷桂劾不當下吏議，當奪官，仍命留任。

translations.literal: Governor-General Huang Tinggui impeached him improperly and referred him to officials for judgment; his rank should have been stripped, but he was still ordered to remain in post.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Huang Tinggui impeached him improperly and referred him to officials for judgment; his rank should have been stripped, but he was still ordered to remain in post.

sentences.zh: 尋入為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he entered the capital as Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he entered the capital as Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十六年，復出為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was again sent out as governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was again sent out as governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 十九年，復入為戶部侍郎，命軍機處行走，旋授兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he again entered the capital as Vice Minister of Revenue, was ordered to serve at the Grand Council, and soon appointed Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he again entered the capital as Vice Minister of Revenue, was ordered to serve at the Grand Council, and soon appointed Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 二十年，師討阿睦爾撒納，授參贊大臣，出北路。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, as the army campaigned against Amursana, he was appointed military assistant and marched out on the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, as the army campaigned against Amursana, he was appointed military assistant and marched out on the northern route.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，命改赴西路，令駐巴里坤辦事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was ordered to shift to the western route and stationed at Barkol to manage affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was ordered to shift to the western route and stationed at Barkol to manage affairs.

sentences.zh: 疏請徙布庫努特降人於烏蘭烏蘇，與前降噶勒雜特人同牧。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting removal of the surrendered Bukunut people to Ulan Usu to pasture together with the earlier surrendered Galjazad people.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized requesting that the surrendered Bukunut people be moved to Ulan Usu to pasture together with the earlier surrendered Galjazad people.

sentences.zh: 未幾，綽羅斯汗噶勒藏多爾濟叛，噶勒雜特人哈薩克錫喇等與為響應，回部降人莽噶里克亦從之。

translations.literal: Before long Choros Khan Galjzadorgi rebelled; the Galjazad Khask Xila and others responded, and the surrendered Muslim Manggarik followed as well.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Choros Khan Galjzadorgi rebelled; the Galjazad Khask Xila and others responded, and the surrendered Muslim Manggarik followed as well.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善擒其黨併其子白和卓。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan captured his partisans together with his son Bai Hezhuo.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan captured his partisans together with his son Bai Hezhuo.

sentences.zh: 十二月，上獎雅爾哈善實心治軍事，加內大臣銜。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the emperor commended Ya Erhashan for conscientiously handling military affairs and granted him the rank of imperial minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the emperor commended Ya Erhashan for conscientiously handling military affairs and granted him the rank of imperial minister.

sentences.zh: 和碩特降酋沙克都爾曼吉不與阿睦爾撒納之亂，率所部徙巴里坤附城為牧地以居。

translations.literal: The surrendered Khoit chief Shakdurfmanji took no part in Amursana's rebellion; he led his people to move to Barkol, settling near the city on pasture land.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered Khoit chief Shakdurfmanji took no part in Amursana's rebellion; he led his people to Barkol and settled near the city on pasture land.

sentences.zh: 噶勒藏多爾濟巴雅爾之叛，上寄諭雅爾哈善，令密察沙克都爾曼吉踪跡。

translations.literal: When Galjzadorgi Bayar rebelled, the emperor sent a confidential instruction to Ya Erhashan ordering him secretly to watch Shakdurfmanji's movements.
translations.idiomatic: When Galjzadorgi Bayar rebelled, the emperor sent a confidential instruction to Ya Erhashan ordering him secretly to watch Shakdurfmanji's movements.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善方內疑，又以餉不時至，沙克都爾曼吉請糧不能給，乃使裨將閻相師將五百人入其壘，若迷途借宿者。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan was himself inwardly suspicious; supplies also did not arrive on time, and when Shakdurfmanji requested grain he could not provide it; he therefore sent lieutenant general Yan Xiangshi with five hundred men into their camp as if lost and seeking lodging.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan was himself inwardly suspicious; supplies also failed to arrive on time, and when Shakdurfmanji requested grain he could not provide it; he therefore sent lieutenant general Yan Xiangshi with five hundred men into their camp as if lost and seeking lodging.

sentences.zh: 夜大雪，相師吹笳，督兵襲其廬。

translations.literal: At night heavy snow fell; Xiangshi sounded the horn and led troops in a surprise attack on their dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: That night heavy snow fell; Xiangshi sounded the horn and led troops in a surprise attack on their dwellings.

sentences.zh: 沙克都爾曼吉驚起，其妻與相抱持，至死不釋，其眾四千餘人殲焉。

translations.literal: Shakdurfmanji started up in alarm; he and his wife embraced each other and did not release until death; more than four thousand of his people were annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: Shakdurfmanji started up in alarm; he and his wife embraced each other and did not release until death, and more than four thousand of his people were annihilated.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善疏報沙克都爾曼吉與綽羅斯叛黨扎那噶爾布相通，戮以杜後患。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan reported in a memorial that Shakdurfmanji was in contact with the Choros rebel Zhanalgarb and had been executed to forestall future trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan reported in a memorial that Shakdurfmanji was in contact with the Choros rebel Zhanalgarb and had been executed to forestall future trouble.

sentences.zh: 又遣兵赴魯克察克剿莽噶里克，上嘉其奮往。

translations.literal: He also dispatched troops to Lukchak to suppress Manggarik; the emperor praised his bold advance.
translations.idiomatic: He also dispatched troops to Lukchak to suppress Manggarik, and the emperor praised his bold advance.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春，定邊右副將軍兆惠自伊犁率師逐捕噶勒藏多爾濟等，雅爾哈善遣侍衛圖倫楚將八百人益兆惠軍。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-second year Right Deputy General for Frontier Pacification Zhao Hui led troops from Yili in pursuit of Galjzadorgi and others; Ya Erhashan sent guardsman Tulunchu with eight hundred men to reinforce Zhao Hui's army.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-second year Right Deputy General for Frontier Pacification Zhao Hui led troops from Yili in pursuit of Galjzadorgi and others, and Ya Erhashan sent guardsman Tulunchu with eight hundred men to reinforce Zhao Hui's army.

sentences.zh: 提督傅魁師至鹽池，遇莽噶里克率三十二人入塞探白和卓消息，傅魁執而殺之，雅爾哈善疏聞。

translations.literal: Provincial Military Commander Fu Kui's army reached Yanchi; they encountered Manggarik leading thirty-two men across the border to spy on news of Bai Hezhuo; Fu Kui seized and killed him; Ya Erhashan reported in a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Military Commander Fu Kui's army reached Yanchi, encountered Manggarik leading thirty-two men across the border to spy on news of Bai Hezhuo, seized and killed him, and Ya Erhashan reported the matter in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 上以莽噶里克為叛首，當讞定行誅，命逮傅魁送京師。

translations.literal: The emperor, holding that Manggarik was the rebel ringleader who ought to have been tried and executed, ordered Fu Kui arrested and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that Manggarik was the rebel ringleader who ought to have been tried and executed, and ordered Fu Kui arrested and sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 兆惠師自濟爾哈朗至特納勒爾，為敵圍，得圖倫楚援乃解。

translations.literal: Zhao Hui's army from Jirhalang to Tinalar was surrounded by the enemy and was relieved only when Tulunchu's reinforcements arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hui's army from Jirhalang to Tinalar was surrounded by the enemy and was relieved only when Tulunchu's reinforcements arrived.

sentences.zh: 尋召雅爾哈善還京師，授戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon Ya Erhashan was recalled to the capital and appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Ya Erhashan was recalled to the capital and appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 四月，复授參贊大臣，令駐濟爾哈朗。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he was again appointed military assistant and ordered to be stationed at Jirhalang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was again appointed military assistant and ordered to be stationed at Jirhalang.

sentences.zh: 九月，擢兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he was promoted to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was promoted to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十二月，令移駐魯克察克，總理屯田。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was ordered to move his station to Lukchak and superintend military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was ordered to move his station to Lukchak and superintend military colonies.

sentences.zh: 二十三年二月，命為靖逆將軍，帥師討霍集占。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-third year he was appointed General for the Pacification of Rebellion and commanded troops against Khoja Jahan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-third year he was appointed General for the Pacification of Rebellion and commanded troops against Khoja Jahan.

sentences.zh: 五月，師至庫車，霍集占所屬頭人阿卜都克勒木城守。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the army reached Kuche; Abdukelimu, a headman under Khoja Jahan, held the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the army reached Kuche, where Abdukelimu, a headman under Khoja Jahan, held the city.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善督師合圍，斷其水草，城賊出戰，屢敗之。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan directed the army in surrounding the city and cutting off its water and fodder; when the garrison sallied, he repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan directed the army in surrounding the city and cutting off its water and fodder, and repeatedly defeated the garrison when it sallied.

sentences.zh: 六月，敗援賊於托木羅克。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he defeated relieving rebels at Tomorok.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he defeated relieving rebels at Tomorok.

sentences.zh: 霍集占自將八千人，具最精巴拉鳥槍，行阿克蘇戈壁來援。

translations.literal: Khoja Jahan personally led eight thousand men armed with the finest bara muskets, crossing the Aksu desert to relieve the city.
translations.idiomatic: Khoja Jahan personally led eight thousand men armed with the finest bara muskets across the Aksu desert to relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善督兵戰庫車南，斬千餘級。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan directed troops in battle south of Kuche and beheaded more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan directed troops in battle south of Kuche and beheaded more than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 霍集占負傷入庫車，獲其纛。

translations.literal: Khoja Jahan, wounded, entered Kuche; his banner was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Khoja Jahan, wounded, entered Kuche, and his banner was captured.

sentences.zh: 庫車依岡為城，以柳枝、沙土密築甚堅，砲攻不能入。

translations.literal: Kuche's city leaned on a hill, densely built with willow branches and sand-soil, very strong; cannon assault could not breach it.
translations.idiomatic: Kuche's city leaned on a hill and was densely built with willow branches and sand-soil, so strong that cannon assault could not breach it.

sentences.zh: 提督馬得勝策穴地入城，距城北一里為隧，已及城。

translations.literal: Provincial Military Commander Ma Desheng planned to enter by mining; a tunnel was dug one li north of the city and had already reached the wall.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Military Commander Ma Desheng planned to enter by mining; a tunnel was dug one li north of the city and had already reached the wall.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善督之急，我兵夜秉燧入穴。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan pressed the operation urgently; our troops entered the tunnel at night carrying torches.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan pressed the operation urgently, and our troops entered the tunnel at night carrying torches.

sentences.zh: 城賊見火光，於城內為橫溝，水入隧，我兵皆沒。

translations.literal: The garrison seeing the fire dug a transverse ditch inside the city; water flooded the tunnel and all our troops perished.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison, seeing the fire, dug a transverse ditch inside the city; water flooded the tunnel and all our troops perished.

sentences.zh: 頭人鄂對告雅爾哈善曰：「庫車食且盡，霍集占必出走。

translations.literal: Headman Odok told Ya Erhashan: "Kuche's food is nearly exhausted; Khoja Jahan is sure to flee.
translations.idiomatic: Headman Odok told Ya Erhashan: "Kuche's food is nearly exhausted; Khoja Jahan is sure to flee.

sentences.zh: 城西鄂根河水淺可涉，北山通戈壁走阿克蘇。

translations.literal: West of the city the Egen River is shallow and fordable; the northern mountains open onto the desert route to Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: West of the city the Egen River is shallow and fordable; the northern mountains open onto the desert route to Aksu.

sentences.zh: 宜分兵屯此二隘，霍集占可擒也。」

translations.literal: Troops should be divided to hold these two passes; Khoja Jahan can be captured."
translations.idiomatic: Troops should be divided to hold these two passes, and Khoja Jahan can be captured."

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善以鄂對新降，不可信。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan, because Odok had newly surrendered, did not trust him.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan, because Odok had newly surrendered, did not trust him.

sentences.zh: 越八日，霍集占乘夜引四百騎啟西門，涉鄂根河遁。

translations.literal: Eight days later Khoja Jahan under cover of night led four hundred horsemen out the west gate, forded the Egen River, and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Eight days later Khoja Jahan under cover of night led four hundred horsemen out the west gate, forded the Egen River, and escaped.

sentences.zh: 又數日，阿卜都克勒木復夜遁。

translations.literal: Several days later Abdukelimu again fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later Abdukelimu again fled by night.

sentences.zh: 餘頭人阿拉難爾等率老弱出城降。

translations.literal: The remaining headmen Alanar and others led the old and weak out of the city to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining headmen Alanar and others led the old and weak out of the city to surrender.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善雜訊城人，謂沙呢雅斯等五人為阿卜都克勒木死黨，因殺之。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan interrogated townspeople indiscriminately, declared Shayniyasi and four others diehard followers of Abdukelimu, and had them killed.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan interrogated townspeople indiscriminately, declared Shayniyasi and four others diehard followers of Abdukelimu, and had them killed.

sentences.zh: 疏入，上聞不得霍集占，盛怒，奪雅爾哈善官。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, the emperor learning Khoja Jahan had not been taken was greatly angered and stripped Ya Erhashan of rank.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor learning Khoja Jahan had not been taken was greatly angered and stripped Ya Erhashan of rank.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善劾副都統順德訥疏縱，又劾馬得勝失機。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan impeached Deputy Lieutenant-General Shundene for laxity and Ma Desheng for missing the opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan impeached Deputy Lieutenant-General Shundene for laxity and Ma Desheng for missing the opportunity.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「雅爾哈善始劾順德訥，繼劾馬得勝，無一語引罪。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Ya Erhashan first impeached Shundene, then impeached Ma Desheng, without a single word acknowledging his own fault.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Ya Erhashan first impeached Shundene, then impeached Ma Desheng, without a single word acknowledging his own fault.

sentences.zh: 不思身任元戎，指麾諸將者誰之責歟？

translations.literal: Does he not reflect that as supreme commander, on whom rests the responsibility for directing the generals?
translations.idiomatic: Does he not reflect that as supreme commander, on whom rests the responsibility for directing the generals?

sentences.zh: 此而不置之法，國憲安在？」

translations.literal: If this is not punished by law, where does the law of the state stand?"
translations.idiomatic: If this is not punished by law, where does the law of the state stand?"

sentences.zh: 命兆惠至軍斬順德訥以徇，逮雅爾哈善及得勝送京師。

translations.literal: He ordered Zhao Hui to reach the army and execute Shundene as a public example, and Ya Erhashan and Desheng arrested and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Zhao Hui to reach the army and execute Shundene as a public example, and Ya Erhashan and Desheng arrested and sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月，逮至，命王公大臣會鞫，以雅爾哈善老師糜餉失機事，論斬，遂見法。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year, when they arrived under arrest, princes and ministers were ordered to join in judgment; for Ya Erhashan's offenses of keeping the army long encamped, wasting supplies, and missing opportunities, he was sentenced to decapitation and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year, when they arrived under arrest, princes and ministers were ordered to join in judgment; for Ya Erhashan's offenses of keeping the army long encamped, wasting supplies, and missing opportunities, he was sentenced to decapitation and executed.

sentences.zh: 後二日，並斬得勝。

translations.literal: Two days later Desheng was also beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later Desheng was also beheaded.

sentences.zh: 自雅爾哈善死，高宗知沙克都爾曼吉無叛狀，賦詩斥其殺降。

translations.literal: After Ya Erhashan's death, the Gaozong Emperor knew Shakdurfmanji had shown no sign of rebellion and composed a poem denouncing the killing of those who had surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: After Ya Erhashan's death, the Gaozong Emperor knew Shakdurfmanji had shown no sign of rebellion and composed a poem denouncing the killing of those who had surrendered.

sentences.zh: 富德，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人，駐防吉林。

translations.literal: Fu De, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner, garrisoned at Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Fu De belonged to the Guwalgiya clan, came from the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner, and was garrisoned at Jilin.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，自護軍擢至三等侍衛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong he rose from guardsman to third-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign he rose from guardsman to third-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 十三年，從經略大學士傅恆徵金川，擒賊黨阿扣，遷二等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he followed Grand Secretary and campaign commander Fu Heng against Jinchuan, captured the rebel partisan A'kou, and was promoted to second-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he followed Grand Secretary and campaign commander Fu Heng against Jinchuan, captured the rebel partisan A'kou, and was promoted to second-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 師還，累遷副都統。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was promoted in succession to deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he rose in succession to deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 二十年，師徵準噶爾，命送綽羅斯台吉噶勒藏多爾濟等赴軍。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, as the army campaigned against the Dzungars, he was ordered to escort Choros taiji Galjzadorgi and others to the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, as the army campaigned against the Dzungars, he was ordered to escort Choros taiji Galjzadorgi and others to the army.

sentences.zh: 擢參贊大臣，督西路台站。

translations.literal: He was promoted to military assistant and supervised relay stations on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to military assistant and supervised relay stations on the western route.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納所屬唐古忒部見阿睦爾撒納入伊犁，謀遁去。

translations.literal: The Tanggute tribes under Amursana, seeing Amursana enter Yili, plotted to flee.
translations.idiomatic: The Tanggute tribes under Amursana, seeing Amursana enter Yili, plotted to flee.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，富德帥師至鄂塔穆和爾，遇唐古忒眾千餘營樹林蒲葦中，擊殺二十餘人，追至色白口山內。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Fu De led troops to Etamhu'er, encountered more than a thousand Tanggute massed in woods and reeds, killed more than twenty in the attack, and pursued them into Sepaikou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Fu De led troops to Etamhu'er, encountered more than a thousand Tanggute massed in woods and reeds, killed more than twenty in the attack, and pursued them into Sepaikou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 賊據險分隊抵禦，奪寨六，斬獲無算。

translations.literal: The rebels defended from advantageous ground in separate detachments; six stockades were taken and killed and captured without count.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held difficult ground and fought in separate bands; six stockades were stormed and the slaughter was beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 唐古忒部遁伊犁，追至察罕鄂博，复遇哈薩克兵千人與唐古忒隊合。

translations.literal: The Tanggute tribes fled toward Yili; pursuit reached Chahan'orbo, where again a thousand Kazakh troops were met joined with the Tanggute column.
translations.idiomatic: The Tanggute tribes fled toward Yili; the pursuers reached Chahan'orbo, where they again encountered a thousand Kazakh troops united with the Tanggute force.

sentences.zh: 富德奮勇衝擊，斬百餘級，奪回被掠集賽噶雜特三十餘戶，擒台吉恩克巴雅爾等四十餘人。

translations.literal: Fu De charged fiercely, beheaded more than a hundred, recovered more than thirty households of Jaisaq-Ghazat who had been carried off, and captured more than forty men including the taiji Enkebayar.
translations.idiomatic: Fu De charged with fierce resolve, took more than a hundred heads, recovered more than thirty plundered Jaisaq-Ghazat households, and captured more than forty men including taiji Enkebayar.

sentences.zh: 上獎富德奮勉，授正黃旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: The emperor rewarded Fu De's vigorous exertion and appointed him Mongol commandant of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended Fu De's vigor and made him Mongol commandant of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，定邊將軍成袞扎布赴巴里坤，以富德為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, General for the Pacification of the Frontier Chengun Zhabu went to Barkol and appointed Fu De military assistant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year General for the Pacification of the Frontier Chengun Zhabu went to Barkol and made Fu De his military assistant.

sentences.zh: 定邊右副將軍兆惠疏報與成袞扎布分道進兵，命富德從兆惠軍。

translations.literal: Right Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier Zhao Hui memorialized that he was advancing by a separate route from Chengun Zhabu; Fu De was ordered to follow Zhao Hui's army.
translations.idiomatic: Right Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier Zhao Hui reported that he was advancing on a route separate from Chengun Zhabu's; Fu De was ordered to join Zhao Hui's force.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納還掠扎那噶爾布游牧，富德追剿，收復巴爾達穆特各鄂拓克。

translations.literal: Amursana again raided the nomadic pastures of Zanagarbu; Fu De pursued and suppressed him and recovered the various otoks of Bardamut.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana again raided the Zanagarbu pastures; Fu De pursued and crushed him, recovering the Bardamut otoks.

sentences.zh: 得叛酋巴雅爾踪跡，遂深入逐捕，奪隘五。

translations.literal: Having obtained traces of the rebel chieftain Bayar, he then pressed deep in pursuit and captured five passes.
translations.idiomatic: Tracking the rebel chieftain Bayar, he pressed deep into the wilds in pursuit and took five passes.

sentences.zh: 至愛登蘇，哈薩克汗阿布賚遣使降。

translations.literal: Reaching Aidengsu, Kazakh Khan Ablai sent envoys to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: At Aidengsu, Kazakh Khan Ablai sent envoys to submit.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納逃入俄羅斯，尋死。

translations.literal: Amursana fled into Russia and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana fled into Russia and soon died.

sentences.zh: 叛酋哈薩克錫喇、布庫察罕未獲，命富德逐捕。

translations.literal: The rebel chieftains Kazakh Sila and Bukuqahan had not been captured; Fu De was ordered to pursue them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel chieftains Kazakh Sila and Bukuqahan remained at large; Fu De was ordered to hunt them down.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，招右部哈薩克圖裡拜及塔什罕回人圖爾佔俱來降，遣​​使入覲。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Tuilibai of the Right Wing Kazakhs and Turzhan, a Muslim of Tashkent, were both induced to surrender and sent envoys to audience at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Tuilibai of the Right Wing Kazakhs and Turzhan, a Muslim of Tashkent, both came over, and envoys were sent to audience at court.

sentences.zh: 上以富德在軍久，招撫西哈薩克有勞，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Because Fu De had been long in the army and had labored to win over the Western Kazakhs, the emperor granted him the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor noted that Fu De had served long in the field and had worked effectively to win over the Western Kazakhs, and granted him the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.

sentences.zh: 是時雅爾哈善討霍集占無功，兆惠代將，師銳進，被圍，命富德為定邊右副將軍赴援。

translations.literal: At this time Ya Erhashan had achieved nothing against Khoja Jahan; Zhao Hui replaced him as commander; the army advanced boldly and was besieged; Fu De was appointed Right Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier to go to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan had made no headway against Khoja Jahan; Zhao Hui replaced him and advanced boldly until his army was surrounded; Fu De was made Right Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier and sent to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月，軍次呼爾璊，遇賊騎五千，轉戰五日四夜。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year the army halted at Hureman and met five thousand rebel horsemen; fighting shifted back and forth for five days and four nights.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year the army camped at Hureman, met five thousand rebel cavalry, and fought on and off for five days and four nights.

sentences.zh: 會參贊大臣阿里袞送馬至，分翼馳突，賊眾大潰，殺巴爾圖十五人、大伯克數十人、賊千餘。

translations.literal: When military assistant Aligun arrived with horses, wings were deployed for a cavalry charge; the rebel host broke utterly; fifteen barut, several dozen major begs, and more than a thousand rebels were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Military assistant Aligun arrived with horses; columns wheeled out in a charge and the rebel mass collapsed; fifteen barut, dozens of senior begs, and more than a thousand rebels were killed.

sentences.zh: 酋布拉呢敦中槍傷劇，舁入城，旋遁喀什噶爾。

translations.literal: The chieftain Burhanuddin was struck by a musket ball and badly wounded; he was carried into the city, then fled to Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: Chieftain Burhanuddin took a musket ball and was gravely wounded; bearers carried him into the city, then he fled to Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 兆惠解圍出，以功封三等伯。

translations.literal: Zhao Hui broke the siege and got out; for his merit he was enfeoffed as a third-rank count.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hui broke out of the encirclement and, for his service, was enfeoffed a third-rank count.

sentences.zh: 師進次葉爾羌河岸，复戰敗賊，進封一等成勇伯。

translations.literal: The army advanced and halted on the bank of the Yarkand River; fighting again it defeated the rebels; he was advanced to first-rank Count of Chengyong.
translations.idiomatic: The army moved up to the Yarkand River, defeated the rebels again, and he was raised to first-rank Count Chengyong.

sentences.zh: 霍集占黨侵和闐，富德赴援，破賊。

translations.literal: Khoja Jahan's faction invaded Khotan; Fu De went to relieve it and broke the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Khoja Jahan's followers invaded Khotan; Fu De went to its relief and routed them.

sentences.zh: 進攻葉爾羌，霍集占兄弟棄城遁，追敗之於阿勒楚爾，又敗之於伊西洱庫爾淖爾，竄巴達克山。

translations.literal: Advancing against Yarkand, the Khoja brothers abandoned the city and fled; they were pursued and defeated at Aletuer, defeated again at Yixihorkor Lake, and driven into Badakhshan.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the attack on Yarkand, the Khoja brothers abandoned the city and fled; pursuers beat them at Aletuer and again at Yixihorkor Lake, driving them into Badakhshan.

sentences.zh: 軍從之，令擒獻，巴達克山汗素勒坦沙獻霍集占首。

translations.literal: The army followed; orders were issued to seize and deliver him; the Khan of Badakhshan, Sultan Shah, presented Khoja Jahan's head.
translations.idiomatic: The army followed in pursuit and ordered him seized and delivered; Sultan Shah, Khan of Badakhshan, sent in Khoja Jahan's head.

sentences.zh: 師還，進封一等靖遠成勇侯，賜雙眼孔雀翎，官其子侍衛，授領侍衛大臣。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was advanced to first-rank Marquis of Jingyuan Chengyong; he was granted the double-eyed peacock feather; his son was appointed bodyguard; he was made Chief Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was raised to first-rank Marquis Jingyuan Chengyong, given the double-eyed peacock plume, his son was made a bodyguard, and he was appointed Chief Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，复授御前大臣，圖形紫光閣，賜紫禁城騎馬，命軍機處行走。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was again appointed imperial presence grand minister, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Glaze, he was granted the privilege of riding within the Forbidden City, and he was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was again made imperial presence grand minister, had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Glaze, was granted horseback riding in the Forbidden City, and was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 尋授理籓院尚書、正黃旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and Mongol commandant of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and Mongol commandant of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 副都統老格盜官駝事發，鞫實，言寄馬富德牧廠，有牲畜數千。

translations.literal: When Deputy Lieutenant-General Laoge's theft of official camels came to light and was investigated, testimony said horses had been entrusted to Fu De's breeding estate and that there were several thousand head of livestock.
translations.idiomatic: When Deputy Lieutenant-General Laoge's embezzlement of official camels was exposed and tried, testimony said horses had been sent to Fu De's ranch—and that he kept several thousand head of livestock.

sentences.zh: 上以富德暴貴，安得有牧廠，命都統巴爾品勘驗，旋奏富德家產擁貲至三萬餘。

translations.literal: The emperor said that Fu De had risen suddenly to wealth—how could he have a breeding estate? Commandant Barpin was ordered to inspect; he soon memorialized that Fu De's household assets amounted to more than thirty thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said a man of Fu De's sudden fortune could scarcely keep a ranch; Commandant Barpin was sent to investigate and soon reported household assets of more than thirty thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 命和親王等會鞫，得富德出兵時留官馬，索蒙古王公牲畜，並攜緞、布、煙、茶牟利狀，下獄，吏議當斬，上命改監候。

translations.literal: Prince He and others were ordered to join in trial; it was established that when Fu De went to war he retained official horses, demanded livestock from Mongol princes and nobles, and carried silk, cloth, tobacco, and tea to profit—he was imprisoned; the legal officials recommended decapitation; the emperor ordered commutation to imprisonment awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: Prince He and others were ordered to sit in judgment; they found that Fu De had kept official horses when he marched, extorted livestock from Mongol princes, and traded in silk, cloth, tobacco, and tea for profit; he was jailed, the legal officers recommended death, and the emperor commuted the sentence to imprisonment awaiting execution.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，赦，授散秩大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was pardoned and appointed supernumerary grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was pardoned and made supernumerary grand minister.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，將軍明瑞徵緬甸死綏，參贊大臣額勒登額坐逗遛得罪。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year General Mingrui died on campaign against Burma; Military Assistant Eledeng'e was punished for loitering and delay.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year General Mingrui died on the Burma campaign; Military Assistant Eledeng'e was punished for dawdling.

sentences.zh: 額勒登額亦吉林駐防，與富德有連，富德坐誤舉，罷散秩大臣，下獄，吏議當斬，上命入緩決。

translations.literal: Eledeng'e was also garrisoned at Jilin and had ties with Fu De; Fu De was convicted of a mistaken recommendation, stripped of supernumerary grand minister rank, imprisoned; legal officials recommended decapitation; the emperor ordered deferred execution.
translations.idiomatic: Eledeng'e had also been garrisoned at Jilin and was connected with Fu De; Fu De was judged for a bad recommendation, removed as supernumerary grand minister, and imprisoned; the legal officers recommended death, and the emperor ordered his case held in deferred execution.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，赦，授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was pardoned and appointed third-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he was pardoned and made third-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，將軍溫福徵金川，軍潰木果木。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year General Wenfu campaigned against Jinchuan; the army was routed at Mugumu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year General Wenfu marched against Jinchuan and his army was routed at Mugumu.

sentences.zh: 發健銳、火器兩營兵益阿桂軍，授富德頭等侍衛，為領隊大臣，從副將軍明亮出南路。

translations.literal: Troops from the Elite and Firearms camps were sent to reinforce Agui's army; Fu De was appointed first-rank bodyguard and expedition commander, following Deputy General Mingliang on the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: Elite and Firearms camp troops were sent to reinforce Agui; Fu De was made first-rank bodyguard and expedition commander and followed Deputy General Mingliang on the southern route.

sentences.zh: 富德自真登、梅列舊卡進兵，克得布甲喇嘛寺、得里兩面山梁、日寨、策爾丹色木諸隘，復進克僧格宗、馬柰、絨布寨、卡卡角諸隘，授副都統，待缺。

translations.literal: Fu De advanced from the old stockades at Zhendeng and Meilie, captured Debujialamas Temple, the ridges on both faces of Deli, Rizhai, Cerdansemu, and other passes; advancing further he captured Senggezong, Mana, Rongbuzhai, Kakaqiao, and other passes; he was appointed deputy lieutenant-general, awaiting vacancy.
translations.idiomatic: Fu De advanced from the old stockades at Zhendeng and Meilie, took Debujialamas Temple, the Deli ridges, Rizhai, Cerdansemu, and other passes, then pushed on to Senggezong, Mana, Rongbuzhai, Kakaqiao, and others; he was made deputy lieutenant-general to fill the next vacancy.

sentences.zh: 復進克沙錫理穆當噶爾碉卡、羊圈河橋。

translations.literal: Advancing further he captured the blockhouse at Shaxilimudangar and Yangquanhe Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: He pushed on and took the Shaxilimudangar blockhouse and Yangquanhe Bridge.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，請撥兵三千往宜喜助明亮，允之。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he requested three thousand troops sent to Yixi to assist Mingliang; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year he asked for three thousand troops to be sent to Yixi to help Mingliang, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 攻噶咱普得婁，奪卡五；

translations.literal: Attacking Gazapudelou, he captured five stockades;
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Gazapudelou, he took five stockades;

sentences.zh: 攻布咱爾尼山梁，奪沿河卡五；

translations.literal: attacking the Burzanir ridge, he captured five stockades along the river;
translations.idiomatic: attacking the Burzanir ridge, he took five riverside stockades;

sentences.zh: 攻庚額特山梁，奪大碉三、卡八；

translations.literal: attacking the Genge'ete ridge, he captured three major blockhouses and eight stockades;
translations.idiomatic: attacking the Genge'ete ridge, he took three major blockhouses and eight stockades;

sentences.zh: 攻噶咱普得爾窩，賊棄碉竄，追至馬爾邦，乞降。

translations.literal: attacking Gazapuderwo, the rebels abandoned their blockhouses and fled; pursuit reached Ma'erbang and they begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: attacking Gazapuderwo, the rebels abandoned their blockhouses and fled; the pursuers reached Ma'erbang, where they begged to surrender.

sentences.zh: 富德從軍二年，未能大有摧破，屢下詔敦責之，至是，命下部敘功。

translations.literal: Fu De had been with the army two years without achieving any great breakthrough; edicts repeatedly rebuked him sternly; at this point the ministries were ordered to record merit.
translations.idiomatic: Fu De had served two years without any major breakthrough; the throne rebuked him again and again; now the ministries were ordered to assess merit for reward.

sentences.zh: 金川平，阿桂劾富德濫賞，侵土兵鹽菜銀兩彌不足，下桂林覈實，復命袁守侗如川會阿桂具獄。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, Agui impeached Fu De for indiscriminate rewards and for encroaching on the salt-and-provisions silver of native troops until the shortfall could not be made up; the case was referred to Guilin for verification, and Yuan Shoutong was again ordered to Sichuan to join Agui in completing the dossier.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified, Agui impeached Fu De for reckless rewards and for diverting native troops' salt-and-provisions silver until the accounts would not balance; the case went to Guilin for verification, and Yuan Shoutong was sent to Sichuan to join Agui in completing the dossier.

sentences.zh: 富德密上清字疏訐阿桂，上命檻送京師。

translations.literal: Fu De secretly submitted a memorial in Manchu script denouncing Agui; the emperor ordered him transported to the capital in a caged cart.
translations.idiomatic: Fu De secretly sent in a Manchu memorial denouncing Agui; the emperor ordered him transported to the capital under guard.

sentences.zh: 廷訊，乃具服濫賞，並以銀六鋌入己；

translations.literal: At court interrogation he fully confessed to indiscriminate rewards and to taking six ingots of silver for himself;
translations.idiomatic: At court interrogation he fully confessed to reckless rewards and to keeping six ingots of silver for himself;

sentences.zh: 又受知府曾承謨餽金五十兩，並劾副將廣著，不待命即令其充兵，廣著自戕死。

translations.literal: he had also accepted fifty taels of gold from Prefect Zeng Chengmo, and had impeached Deputy General Guangzhu, ordering him reduced to common soldier without awaiting approval—Guangzhu killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: he had also taken fifty taels of gold from Prefect Zeng Chengmo, and had impeached Deputy General Guangzhu and ordered him reduced to common soldier without awaiting approval—whereupon Guangzhu killed himself.

sentences.zh: 清字疏復稱「阿桂手持黃帶，語不遜」，坐誣告大逆，例當斬，遂見法。

translations.literal: The Manchu memorial also stated that "Agui held the yellow sash and spoke insolently"; for this false accusation of treason, the statute prescribed decapitation, and he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: The Manchu memorial also claimed that "Agui held the yellow sash and spoke insolently"; judged guilty of a false charge of treason, he was sentenced to decapitation by statute and executed.

sentences.zh: 薩賴爾，蒙古正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Salai'er was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Salai'er was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 本厄魯特頭人，隸準噶爾台吉達什達瓦為宰桑。

translations.literal: Originally a Zunghar headman, he served under the Zunghar taiji Dashdawa as zaisang.
translations.idiomatic: Originally a Zunghar headman, he had served the Zunghar taiji Dashdawa as zaisang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十五年，準噶爾內亂，薩賴爾率所屬四十七戶降，安置察哈爾。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Qianlong, during internal strife in Zungharia, Salai'er led the forty-seven households under him to surrender and was settled in Chahar.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 15, amid Zunghar civil war, Salai'er led his forty-seven households in surrender and was settled in Chahar.

sentences.zh: 命入旗，授散秩大臣。

translations.literal: He was ordered enrolled in the banners and appointed supernumerary grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was enrolled in the banners and made supernumerary grand minister.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾台吉喇嘛達爾扎請遣薩賴爾歸，不許。

translations.literal: The Zunghar taiji Lama Darja requested that Salai'er be sent back; permission was refused.
translations.idiomatic: The Zunghar taiji Lama Darja asked that Salai'er be returned; the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 授參贊大臣，出北路。

translations.literal: He was appointed military assistant and sent out on the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: He was made military assistant and sent out on the northern route.

sentences.zh: 十九年，烏梁海得木齊扎木參入邊，薩賴爾以五百人御之，擒扎木參，而遣收凌、朔岱、訥庫勒等十人還。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year the Uriankhai Demuchi Zhamucan crossed the border; Salai'er with five hundred men resisted him, captured Zhamucan, and sent back Shouling, Shuodai, Nekule, and nine others.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year the Uriankhai Demuchi Zhamucan crossed the frontier; Salai'er met him with five hundred men, captured Zhamucan, and sent back Shouling, Shuodai, Nekule, and nine others.

sentences.zh: 事聞，授內大臣。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was appointed inner grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached court, he was made inner grand minister.

sentences.zh: 既，遣還諸人來告宰桑雅爾都、得木齊阿茂海欲來歸，乞駐牧烏蘭固木、克木剋木齊克。

translations.literal: Later the men who had been sent back reported that the zaisang Yardu and Demuchi Amaohai wished to come over and begged to pasture at Ulan Gumu and Kemukemqike.
translations.idiomatic: Later the men who had been sent back reported that zaisang Yardu and Demuchi Amaohai wished to submit and asked to pasture at Ulan Gumu and Kemukemqike.

sentences.zh: 薩賴爾言雅爾都等親至，許駐特斯河，否則驅之阿爾台山外；

translations.literal: Salai'er said that if Yardu and the others came in person they would be allowed to pasture at the Tesi River, otherwise they would be driven beyond the Altai Mountains;
translations.idiomatic: Salai'er said that if Yardu and the others came in person they could pasture at the Tesi River, otherwise they would be driven beyond the Altai;

sentences.zh: 並請發厄魯特兵聽調。

translations.literal: he also requested that Zunghar troops be dispatched for his command.
translations.idiomatic: he also asked that Zunghar troops be placed at his disposal.

sentences.zh: 尚書舒赫德以為未便，上諭薩賴爾相機而行。

translations.literal: Minister Shuhede considered this inadvisable; the emperor instructed Salai'er to act according to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Shuhede thought this unwise; the emperor told Salai'er to act as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 命舒赫德會同薩賴爾及車凌等選台吉、宰桑可信任者將兵二百人，並令侍衛永柱會總管阿敏道選察哈爾八旗兵五百，交薩賴爾為招諭驅逐之用。

translations.literal: Shuhede was ordered to join Salai'er and Cheleng and others in selecting trustworthy taiji and zaisang to command two hundred troops; the bodyguard Yongzhu was also ordered to join Supervisor Amin'dao in selecting five hundred Chahar Eight Banner troops and handing them to Salai'er for use in winning over and expelling the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede was ordered to work with Salai'er, Cheleng, and others to choose trustworthy taiji and zaisang to lead two hundred men; bodyguard Yongzhu was also told to join Supervisor Amin'dao in selecting five hundred Chahar Banner troops and placing them under Salai'er to win over and drive off the enemy.

sentences.zh: 薩賴爾兵至卓克索，烏梁海宰桑雅爾都、車根、赤倫、察達克、圖布慎、瑪濟岱各鄂拓克竄徙阿爾台山外。

translations.literal: When Salai'er's troops reached Zhuokesuo, the Uriankhai zaisang Yardu, Chegen, Chilun, Chadak, Tubushen, and Majidai and their various otoks fled and moved beyond the Altai Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: When Salai'er's troops reached Zhuokesuo, the Uriankhai zaisang Yardu, Chegen, Chilun, Chadak, Tubushen, and Majidai and their otoks fled beyond the Altai.

sentences.zh: 薩賴爾奏：「烏梁海等已遠遁，但貪戀故土，必仍回牧。

translations.literal: Salai'er memorialized: "The Uriankhai and others have fled far away, but clinging to their old lands they will surely return to pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Salai'er memorialized: "The Uriankhai have fled far off, but they cling to their old pastures and will surely return.

sentences.zh: 彼時整兵速出，易於收服。

translations.literal: At that time, if troops are mustered and sent out swiftly, they will be easy to subdue.
translations.idiomatic: If we muster troops and strike quickly then, they will be easy to bring to heel.

sentences.zh: 請暫撤兵還。」

translations.literal: I request that the troops be temporarily withdrawn."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the troops be withdrawn for now."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 輝特台吉阿睦爾撒納來降，命薩賴爾迎勞頒賞。

translations.literal: When the Khoit taiji Amursana came to surrender, Salai'er was ordered to welcome him, express the court's regard, and distribute rewards.
translations.idiomatic: When Khoit taiji Amursana surrendered, Salai'er was ordered to welcome him, express the court's regard, and distribute rewards.

sentences.zh: 旋偕喀爾喀貝子車木楚克扎布等以千八百人擊雅爾都、車根、赤倫、察達克四宰桑於察罕烏蘇，敗之，獲牛馬無算。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, together with the Khalkha prince Chemchukjab and others, he struck the four zaisang Yardu, Chegen, Chilun, and Chadak at Chahan Usu with eighteen hundred men, defeated them, and captured cattle and horses beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, with Khalkha prince Chemchukjab and others, he attacked the four zaisang Yardu, Chegen, Chilun, and Chadak at Chahan Usu with eighteen hundred men, routed them, and seized cattle and horses beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 初，有紮哈沁宰桑庫克新瑪木特者犯卡倫，追之弗獲，達青阿誘執之。

translations.literal: Earlier there was a Zhakhcin zaisang named Kukxin Mamute who violated a border post; pursuit failed to capture him, but Daqing'a lured and seized him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier a Zhakhcin zaisang named Kukxin Mamute had violated a border post; pursuers failed to take him, but Daqing'a lured him in and captured him.

sentences.zh: 上責其不武，令縱之去。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked him for lack of martial spirit and ordered Mamute released.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked him for timidity and ordered Mamute set free.

sentences.zh: 瑪木特移牧布拉罕託輝，不即降。

translations.literal: Mamute moved his herds to Bulahan Tuohui and did not surrender at once.
translations.idiomatic: Mamute moved his herds to Bulahan Tuohui and did not submit at once.

sentences.zh: 道遇通瑪木特，被擒，縶之諾海克卜特勒。

translations.literal: On the road he met Tongmamute, was captured, and was bound at Nohaikebtule.
translations.idiomatic: On the road he met Tongmamute, was taken captive, and was bound at Nohaikebtule.

sentences.zh: 薩賴爾诇知之，自烏蘭山後掩擒通瑪木特，並護庫克新瑪木特送軍營，安置其戶畜於庫卜克爾克勒。

translations.literal: Salai'er learned of this through reconnaissance, swept around from behind Ulan Mountain to capture Tongmamute by surprise, escorted Kukxin Mamute to camp, and settled his households and livestock at Kubkeerkele.
translations.idiomatic: Salai'er learned of it through scouts, swept around from behind Ulan Mountain to seize Tongmamute by surprise, escorted Kukxin Mamute to camp, and settled his households and livestock at Kubkeerkele.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之，授子爵世襲，遷正白旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: The emperor commended him, granted him a hereditary viscounty, and transferred him to Chief Bodyguard and inner grand minister of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended him, granted him a hereditary viscounty, and made him Chief Bodyguard and inner grand minister of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 時定議徵達瓦齊，命薩賴爾為定邊右副將軍。

translations.literal: At that time it was decided to campaign against Dawachi; Salai'er was appointed Right Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier.
translations.idiomatic: When the court resolved to campaign against Dawachi, Salai'er was made Right Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月，率師偕參贊大臣鄂容安等出西路。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year he led the army together with military assistant Erceng'an and others out on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twentieth year he led the army out on the western route with military assistant Erceng'an and others.

sentences.zh: 師行，厄魯特降者於途中肆劫。

translations.literal: As the army marched, surrendered Zunghars plundered along the route.
translations.idiomatic: As the army marched, surrendered Zunghars plundered along the way.

sentences.zh: 上戒鄂容安，以己意喻薩賴爾使自斂戢。

translations.literal: The emperor admonished Erceng'an to convey his intent to Salai'er and have him restrain them himself.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor admonished Erceng'an to convey his wishes to Salai'er and have him rein them in.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納請移牧烏里雅蘇台，招輝特部眾。

translations.literal: Amursana requested to move his pastures to Uliastai and summon the Khoit tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana asked to move his pastures to Uliastai and rally the Khoit tribes.

sentences.zh: 上察其意叵測，諭薩賴爾令防範，並促其進兵。

translations.literal: The emperor perceived his intent to be unpredictable and instructed Salai'er to guard against him and also urged him to advance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor saw his intent as unreliable and told Salai'er to guard against him while pressing him to advance.

sentences.zh: 薩賴爾等疏報扎哈沁得木齊巴哈曼集以三百餘戶，宰桑敦多克以千餘戶來降。

translations.literal: Salai'er and others memorialized that the Zhakhcin Demuchi Bahmanji with more than three hundred households and the zaisang Dundok with more than a thousand households had come to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Salai'er and others reported that the Zhakhcin Demuchi Bahmanji with more than three hundred households and zaisang Dundok with more than a thousand had surrendered.

sentences.zh: 復遣侍衛瑚集圖招諭達瓦齊同族台吉噶勒藏多爾濟，尋率台吉諾海奇齊等三十餘人來降，詔封為綽羅斯汗。

translations.literal: He again dispatched the bodyguard Hujitu to win over Galjzadorgi, a taiji of Dawachi's clan; shortly thereafter Galjzadorgi led more than thirty men including the taiji Nohaiqiqi to surrender, and an edict enfeoffed him as Khan of Choros.
translations.idiomatic: He again sent bodyguard Hujitu to win over Galjzadorgi, a taiji of Dawachi's clan; soon Galjzadorgi led more than thirty men including taiji Nohaiqiqi in surrender, and an edict enfeoffed him Khan of Choros.

sentences.zh: 上諭獎薩賴爾，解所佩荷包以賜，並賜雙眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: The emperor issued commendation to Salai'er, removed the purse from his own belt and granted it to him, and also granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended Salai'er, took the purse from his own belt and gave it to him, and also granted the double-eyed peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 三月，薩賴爾與諸將和起、齊努渾自羅克倫督兵赴博羅塔拉，與北路班第等軍合。

translations.literal: In the third month Salai'er, together with the generals Heqi and Qinuhun, directed troops from Luokelun toward Bortala and joined the northern-route army under Bandi and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Salai'er, with generals Heqi and Qinuhun, led troops from Luokelun toward Bortala and joined Bandi's northern-route army.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「招撫綽羅斯台吉袞布扎卜等，皆率所屬來降，凡四千餘戶。

translations.literal: A memorial stated: "The Choros taiji Gunbuzhab and others have been won over; all have led their followers to surrender, totaling more than four thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: A memorial stated: "Choros taiji Gunbuzhab and others have been won over; all have led their followers in surrender, more than four thousand households in all.

sentences.zh: 葉爾羌、喀什噶爾和卓木獻玉盤請降，令各回原牧；

translations.literal: The Khojas of Yarkand and Kashgar presented a jade platter and requested surrender; they were ordered each to return to his original pastures;
translations.idiomatic: The Khojas of Yarkand and Kashgar sent a jade platter to sue for peace; each was ordered back to his original pastures;

sentences.zh: 降人請與地耕牧，令往吐魯番、莽阿里克處受地。

translations.literal: the surrendered people requested land for farming and herding and were ordered to go to Turpan and Mangalike to receive allotments.
translations.idiomatic: the surrendered people asked for land to farm and herd and were sent to Turpan and Mangalike to receive allotments.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納屬人二百餘及額林哈畢爾噶窮夷八百餘戶，令附屬扎哈沁宰桑，有牲畜者，畀耔種，令其耕牧。

translations.literal: More than two hundred followers of Amursana and more than eight hundred impoverished households of Elinhabirga were ordered attached to the Zhakhcin zaisang; those with livestock were given seed grain and ordered to farm and herd.
translations.idiomatic: More than two hundred of Amursana's followers and more than eight hundred impoverished Elinhabirga households were placed under the Zhakhcin zaisang; those with livestock were given seed grain and set to farming and herding.

sentences.zh: 並自羅克倫啟行，馳檄達瓦齊，曉諭利害。」

translations.literal: Setting out from Luokelun, he also sent a fast dispatch to Dawachi explaining advantage and harm."
translations.idiomatic: Setting out from Luokelun, he also sent a fast dispatch to Dawachi setting out the stakes."

sentences.zh: 上獎其籌畫妥協，以御用寶石朝珠賜之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended his thorough and well-coordinated planning and granted him an imperial court necklace of precious stones.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended his careful planning and granted him an imperial court necklace set with precious stones.

sentences.zh: 薩賴爾兵至登努勒台，將軍班第等亦至尼楚袞，兩軍合。

translations.literal: Salai'er's army reached Dengnuletai; General Bandi and others also reached Nichugun; the two armies joined.
translations.idiomatic: Salai'er's army reached Dengnuletai; General Bandi and others reached Nichugun; the two armies united.

sentences.zh: 達瓦齊居伊犁河西格登，不設備。

translations.literal: Dawachi dwelt at Geden on the west bank of the Ili River and made no preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Dawachi was at Geden on the west bank of the Ili and made no preparations.

sentences.zh: 五月，西路軍自固勒扎渡口越推墨爾里克嶺直抵格登，達瓦齊驚遁，未幾就擒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the western-route army crossed from the Gulezha ford over Tuimo'erlike Ridge straight to Geden; Dawachi fled in alarm and was soon captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the western-route army crossed at the Gulezha ford over Tuimo'erlike Ridge straight to Geden; Dawachi fled in alarm and was captured soon after.

sentences.zh: 伊犁平，詔封薩賴爾一等超勇公，賜寶石頂、四團龍服。

translations.literal: Yili was pacified; an edict enfeoffed Salai'er as first-rank Duke of Chaoyong, granting a hat knob of precious stones and a four-round-dragon robe.
translations.idiomatic: Yili was pacified; an edict enfeoffed Salai'er first-rank Duke Chaoyong, with a precious-stone hat knob and a four-round-dragon robe.

sentences.zh: 六月，軍還。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the army returned.

sentences.zh: 徵阿睦爾撒納入覲，薩賴爾同班第、鄂容安駐守伊犁，留兵五百為衛。

translations.literal: Amursana was summoned to audience at court; Salai'er together with Bandi and Erceng'an garrisoned Yili, leaving five hundred troops as guard.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana was summoned to court; Salai'er, Bandi, and Erceng'an garrisoned Yili and left five hundred troops as guard.

sentences.zh: 七月，阿睦爾撒納謀叛，逗遛途中。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Amursana plotted rebellion and loitered on the road.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Amursana plotted rebellion and dawdled on the road.

sentences.zh: 班第等屢疏入告，薩賴爾亦以為言。

translations.literal: Bandi and others repeatedly memorialized to report it; Salai'er also spoke to the same effect.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi and others sent repeated memorials reporting it; Salai'er said the same.

sentences.zh: 上密諭諸臣擒治，弗能決，阿睦爾撒納遂遁。

translations.literal: The emperor secretly instructed the ministers to seize and punish him, but they could not decide; Amursana then fled.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor secretly ordered the ministers to seize and punish him, but they could not bring themselves to act; Amursana fled.

sentences.zh: 其徒克什木等為亂，班第、鄂容安死之，薩賴爾更衣降。

translations.literal: His followers Keshimu and others raised rebellion; Bandi and Erceng'an died in it; Salai'er changed clothes and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: His followers Keshimu and others rose in revolt; Bandi and Erceng'an were killed; Salai'er doffed his uniform and went over to the enemy.

sentences.zh: 十二月，薩賴爾遣使詣巴里坤辦事大臣和起，以阿睦爾撒納踪跡告，請發兵往擊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Salai'er sent envoys to the Barkol administrative commissioner Heqi, reporting Amursana's movements and requesting troops sent to strike him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Salai'er sent envoys to Barkol administrative commissioner Heqi with word of Amursana's movements and a request for troops to strike him.

sentences.zh: 和起以聞，上令將軍策楞傳諭慰勞，賚荷包、鼻煙壺，俟其至賜之。

translations.literal: Heqi reported this; the emperor ordered General Ce Leng to convey words of consolation, and bestowed a purse and snuff bottle to be given when Salai'er arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Heqi reported the matter; the emperor had General Ce Leng convey his regards and sent a purse and snuff bottle to be presented when Salai'er arrived.

sentences.zh: 又命理籓院員外郎唐喀祿董其游牧。

translations.literal: He also ordered Court of Colonial Affairs vice director Tangkalu to supervise their pastoral encampments.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered Court of Colonial Affairs vice director Tangkalu to oversee their pastoral camps.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月，薩賴爾脫出，至吐魯番。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-first year Salai'er escaped and reached Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-first year Salai'er broke free and reached Turfan.

sentences.zh: 巴里坤參贊大臣達爾黨阿率兵往會。

translations.literal: Military assistant at Barkol Da Erdang'a led troops to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Da Erdang'a, military assistant at Barkol, marched out to meet him.

sentences.zh: 薩賴爾疏請罪，上令駐特訥格爾，仍授定邊右副將軍。

translations.literal: Salai'er memorialized asking forgiveness; the emperor ordered him to garrison at Teneger and again appointed him Right Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Salai'er submitted a plea for pardon; the emperor ordered him to garrison at Teneger and restored him as Right Deputy General for the Pacification of the Frontier.

sentences.zh: 三月，策楞疏言：「侍衛巴寧阿自伊犁歸，言克什木之亂，將軍班第等自固勒扎赴崆格斯御之。

translations.literal: In the third month Ce Leng memorialized: "Bodyguard Baning'a returned from Yili and reported that in the turmoil caused by Keshimu, General Bandi and others had gone from Gulezha to Konggesi to resist the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Ce Leng reported: "Bodyguard Baning'a returned from Yili and said that during Keshimu's revolt General Bandi and others had marched from Gulezha to Konggesi to face the rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊甫至，薩賴爾欲奔。

translations.literal: When the rebels had just arrived, Salai'er wished to flee.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as the rebels appeared Salai'er wanted to run.

sentences.zh: 鄂容安曰：'賊來當戰，胡急走？

translations.literal: Erong'an said: 'When the enemy comes one should fight — why flee in haste?
translations.idiomatic: Erong'an said, 'When the enemy comes we should fight — why run away in panic?

sentences.zh: '薩賴爾答言：'爾何知？

translations.literal: ' Salai'er replied: 'What do you know?
translations.idiomatic: Salai'er answered, 'What do you know about this?

sentences.zh: '遂策馬去，眾從之。

translations.literal: He then spurred his horse away and the troops followed him.
translations.idiomatic: He spurred his horse away and the troops followed.

sentences.zh: 班第等僅餘司員侍衛及衛卒六十人。

translations.literal: Bandi and the others had only clerks, bodyguards, and sixty guardsmen left.
translations.idiomatic: Bandi and his party were left with only clerks, bodyguards, and sixty guardsmen.

sentences.zh: 夜賊至，班第等遂自殺。」

translations.literal: That night the rebels arrived and Bandi and the others took their own lives."
translations.idiomatic: That night the rebels came and Bandi and the others killed themselves."

sentences.zh: 上命逮薩賴爾入都，鞫實，以薩賴爾降人，貸其死，命錮之獄。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Salai'er arrested and brought to the capital; the facts were investigated, and because Salai'er was a surrendered tribesman his life was spared and he was ordered imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Salai'er brought to the capital for trial; because he was a surrendered tribesman his life was spared and he was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 班第等喪還，執克什木馘以祭，令薩賴爾觀之。

translations.literal: When Bandi's remains were returned, Keshimu was seized and his head offered in sacrifice; Salai'er was made to witness it.
translations.idiomatic: When Bandi's body was brought back, Keshimu was taken and his head offered in sacrifice before Salai'er's eyes.

sentences.zh: 尋以叛黨漸次就擒，釋出獄。

translations.literal: Soon, as the rebel faction was gradually captured, he was released from prison.
translations.idiomatic: As rebel leaders were captured one after another, he was soon released from prison.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，授散秩大臣、鑲白旗蒙古副都統、乾清門行走。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was appointed minister without portfolio, vice commander-in-chief of the Mongol Bordered White Banner, and attendant at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was made minister without portfolio, vice commander-in-chief of the Mongol Bordered White Banner, and attendant at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 旋擢內大臣，复封二等超勇伯。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was promoted to grand minister and again enfeoffed as a second-rank Earl of Chaoyong.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to grand minister and again made a second-rank Earl of Chaoyong.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was hung in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 論曰：國重有世臣，然承平久，富貴宴安，恆不足任使；

translations.literal: The commentary says: The state values hereditary ministers, yet after long peace wealth and ease make them habitually unfit for appointment;
translations.idiomatic: The commentary observes: The dynasty esteems hereditary ministers, but after long peace wealth and comfort usually leave them unfit for duty;

sentences.zh: 出任軍旅，兵未接，將已內怯，幾何不僨事耶？

translations.literal: when sent to the army, before battle is joined the generals are already inwardly timid — how could campaigns not fail?
translations.idiomatic: sent to war, they are often cowed before battle is even joined — how could campaigns not go wrong?

sentences.zh: 策楞輩擁兵玩寇，其病正坐此。

translations.literal: Ce Leng and his like held troops yet toyed with the enemy; their fault lay precisely here.
translations.idiomatic: Men like Ce Leng held armies yet dallied with the enemy — their failing was exactly this.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善文墨吏，其殺降亦以內怯。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan was a clerk of the brush; his slaughter of those who surrendered also sprang from inward fear.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan was a literary official; his massacre of surrendering troops likewise came from inner cowardice.

sentences.zh: 富德族微，力戰致通顯，有功而不善居，卒以遘禍。

translations.literal: Fu De came from a humble clan, won distinction through hard fighting, had merit yet did not know how to conduct himself, and in the end met disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Fu De was of humble birth, rose through fierce fighting, earned merit but could not restrain himself, and finally came to ruin.

sentences.zh: 薩賴爾反覆，★甚著，獨以降人蒙寬典，幸矣！

translations.literal: Salai'er was treacherous and his guilt glaring, yet as a surrendered tribesman alone he received imperial leniency — fortunate indeed!
translations.idiomatic: Salai'er was treacherous and his offenses conspicuous; only as a surrendered tribesman did he receive the court's mercy — how fortunate!
